Tim Nazzaro, gerente global de produtos digitais da Hartford Steam Boiler, dividiu os riscos da IA em três categorias. Primeiro, riscos relacionados à segurança e à privacidade, como o vazamento de dados pessoais por uma ferramenta de IA. Ele afirmou que a empresa é responsável por isso e que “isso deve estar claramente contemplado em uma apólice de segurança eletrônica”. A segunda categoria diz respeito a outras linhas de seguro, por exemplo, uma ferramenta de IA que discrimine na contratação se enquadraria em uma apólice de responsabilidade civil por práticas trabalhistas. A terceira categoria abrange novos riscos que “não têm um lugar definido”, disse Nazzaro. Ele alertou o setor de segurança digital contra o hábito de optar por “ampliar a cobertura, simplesmente incluir o risco, sem fazer a subscrição”. “Acho que isso poderia ser incluído em uma apólice cibernética, mas, se for o caso, precisamos garantir que estamos avaliando esses riscos”, disse ele. Ele citou as novas regulamentações sobre IA. Multas por violação de regras que não sejam leis de privacidade podem não se enquadrar em uma apólice cibernética, afirmou. Danielle Roth, líder de prática e chefe de sinistros cibernéticos para a América do Norte na Axa XL, disse que as seguradoras não devem tratar a IA como “um monólito”. Em vez disso, afirmou ela, devem voltar à análise básica da cobertura: quem é o segurado, qual é o sinistro, se ele aciona algum acordo de seguro e se há exclusões aplicáveis. “Talvez nem saibamos, em caso de violação, se a IA foi usada ou não. Podemos especular, mas talvez nunca venhamos a descobrir”, disse Roth. Ela defendeu que os segurados trabalhem com seus corretores para avaliar seus próprios riscos. Arkin, da Berkley, comparou a situação a um “risco cibernético silencioso”, observando que “a exposição à IA estará presente em todas as apólices de seguro existentes. No momento, trata-se apenas de uma IA silenciosa”. EXPLOSÃO DE ATAQUES Michael Brunetti, vice-presidente de resposta a incidentes da MOXFIVE, disse que sua empresa está mais ocupada desde por volta de 4 de julho do que nunca. O ransomware tradicional e a dupla extorsão ainda são comuns, mas os ataques a serviços de computação em nuvem são onde “as coisas estão mudando”, afirmou ele. Ele citou grupos como o ShinyHunters, que têm como alvo aplicativos de software como serviço (SaaS). Esses grupos não precisam mais invadir uma rede e criptografar tudo, disse Brunetti. Em vez disso, eles usam IA para vasculhar dados roubados em busca do material mais sensível, escrevem mensagens de extorsão que fazem a ameaça “parecer muito mais assustadora” e criam rapidamente perfis de executivos. Um trabalho que costumava levar dias ou semanas agora leva minutos ou horas, afirmou ele. Roth disse que a Axa XL também teve um verão bastante agitado e observou que grande parte disso se deveu a ataques a escritórios de advocacia, que, segundo ela, substituíram o setor de saúde como alvo preferido. A maioria dos ataques se baseou em phishing, em vez de novas técnicas de IA, disse ela, e os funcionários continuam sendo o maior ponto forte ou o elo mais fraco de uma empresa.

item.title: US appeals court weighs block on Kennedy's vaccine panel appointments
item.description: A lawyer for the Trump administration told a federal appeals court on Tuesday that a judge had improperly hamstrung an influential vaccine advisory panel by blocking Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s handpicked appointees from serving on it.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A lawyer for the Trump administration told a federal appeals court on Tuesday that a judge had improperly hamstrung an influential vaccine advisory panel by blocking Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s handpicked appointees from serving on it. US Justice Department attorney Matthew Zorn argued at a hearing before the 1st US Circuit Court of Appeals in Boston that the judge's ruling was preventing the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices from meeting due to concerns that any new appointments Kennedy made to it could also be blocked. "We're asking the court to vacate the order on the appointments so that the secretary can reconstitute the committee and get it back to work," Zorn said. Kennedy, an anti-vaccine activist picked by President Donald Trump last year to head the US Department of Health and Human Services, removed and replaced all 17 independent experts who previously served on the panel, which makes recommendations on vaccine policy to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. That action formed the basis of the lawsuit by the American Academy of Pediatrics and other medical groups, which also sought to block other shifts in vaccine policy under Kennedy. US District Judge Brian Murphy in a [USN:L1N40410J TEXT:"March 16 order"] concluded that Kennedy, in picking new members, did not comply with the Federal Advisory Committee Act, which requires such advisory panels to be balanced, and instead picked "distinctly unqualified" individuals to serve on the committee that is supposed to be composed of experts on vaccines and immunization. The Trump administration contends that portion of Murphy's order has deprived ACIP of a quorum needed to issue recommendations on flu shots and other vaccines because any newly appointed members would likely require court approval. Some members of the three-judge appeals court panel on Tuesday raised concerns about how Murphy had crafted his order, which blocked 13 appointees from serving. Chief US Circuit Judge David Barron said it lacked any explanation for why blocking Kennedy's appointees was legally authorized or justified. "It's hard to know precisely what harm this relief was designed to address," he said. But Andrew Pincus, a lawyer for the plaintiffs, urged the court to leave it in place, saying Murphy's decision to block 13 of the panel's members from continuing to serve provided "important protection for America's public health." Murphy in his order also blocked the CDC's January 5 move to cut the number of routinely recommended childhood vaccinations and set aside votes ACIP had taken under Kennedy's watch, including to downgrade recommendations for hepatitis B vaccines for newborns and COVID-19 shots broadly. The Trump administration [USN:L1N42Q0L9 TEXT:"opted against"] appealing those portions of that ruling by Murphy, an appointee of Democratic President Joe Biden, and instead focused narrowly on his decision blocking the 13 appointees to the vaccine panel. Since Murphy ruled, ACIP has not met, canceling two meetings so far. Another, set for October 21-23, would likely also be canceled if the committee is not reconstituted before then.

item.title: Video de un avión fue alterado para incluir gritos y no corresponde al incidente de flydubai
item.description: Un video que muestra una ventana de un avión en el que se ven edificaciones costeras y se escuchan gritos no corresponde al incidente reportado el 30 de septiembre en el vuelo de Dubái a Tel Aviv de la aerolínea flydubai, como dicen publicaciones en redes sociales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un video que muestra una ventana de un avión en el que se ven edificaciones costeras y se escuchan gritos no corresponde al incidente reportado el 30 de septiembre en el vuelo de Dubái a Tel Aviv de la aerolínea flydubai, como dicen publicaciones en redes sociales. Estos son los datos clave: Publicaciones en redes sociales compartieron el video alterado el 30 de septiembre con la descripción: “Terror en el aire: copiloto habría apuñalado al capitán en vuelo rumbo a Tel Aviv”. Horas antes de que se publicara el video, Reuters informó que el vuelo FZ1073 de flydubai fue desviado a Arabia Saudita tras un incidente a bordo. Posteriormente, las autoridades israelíes [USN:S8N44D013 TEXT:"dijeron"] que el copiloto había apuñalado al capitán para intentar estrellar el avión, pero que los pasajeros y la tripulación lo impidieron. El video de redes sociales es de otro vuelo de flydubai, que estaba cruzando la costa emiratí en dirección al Aeropuerto Internacional de Dubái. Los datos del rastreador de vuelos FlightRadar24 muestran que el vuelo FZ1073 viajó en dirección opuesta a la aeronave que aparece en el video y entró brevemente en el espacio aéreo jordano, a casi 2,000 km de Dubái, antes de desviarse hacia Arabia Saudita. El audio de la gente gritando fue tomado de otro video no relacionado publicado en TikTok en junio de 2022. Las características geográficas del video de TikTok coinciden con una zona montañosa cerca de Ushuaia, Argentina. El usuario de TikTok, un DJ argentino llamado Nico Vallorani, dijo en una publicación que grabó el video en un vuelo a Ushuaia, y la gente gritó porque el avión estaba experimentando turbulencias. Vallorani no respondió a una solicitud de comentarios. Un análisis realizado con la herramienta de verificación de Meta Platforms, que detecta marcas de agua invisibles incrustadas en el contenido multimedia generado, determinó que el video probablemente fue editado o creado utilizando los modelos de IA de la empresa tecnológica. Veredicto: Alterado. El audio y las imágenes se han editado a partir de fuentes separadas, y no corresponden al incidente aéreo ocurrido en el vuelo FZ1073 el 30 de septiembre de 2026. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para  México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: EPA air chief leaves agency after overseeing Trump regulatory rollback
item.description: The Environmental Protection Agency official who has overseen some of the Trump administration's most consequential efforts to roll back climate and air pollution regulations resigned effective last week, the agency said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Siddharth Cavale
item.content:encoded: The Environmental Protection Agency official who has overseen some of the Trump administration's most consequential efforts to roll back climate and air pollution regulations resigned effective last week, the agency said on Tuesday. Aaron Szabo, an attorney who led the EPA's Office of Air and Radiation since 2025 as an assistant administrator, departed on Friday. The EPA had previously said Szabo would leave in July but asked him to remain longer. Reuters reported at the time that his planned [USN:L6N43U131 TEXT:"move to a law firm"] had fallen through. At EPA, Szabo oversaw programs covering air pollution, vehicle emissions, blending gasoline with renewable fuels and other major Clean Air Act provisions. During his tenure, the EPA moved to repeal its 2009 finding that greenhouse gases endanger public health and welfare, a step that could substantially limit its authority to regulate climate pollution. The office also worked on rolling back emissions rules covering power plants, vehicles and the oil and gas industry. The EPA, in an email to Reuters, thanked Szabo for his “tremendous work” advancing President Donald Trump's agenda. The agency said his office helped deliver “the single largest deregulatory action in U.S. history” and valued deregulatory cost savings during Szabo's tenure at more than $1.6 trillion. The EPA said Justin Schwab, who serves as a senior adviser to EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin, has been nominated to replace Szabo. Szabo and Schwab did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

item.title: Mike Flanagan reimagina “Carrie” para uma nova geração que enfrenta cyberbullying e simulações de tiroteio nas escolas
item.description: “Carrie” retorna nesta semana em uma nova adaptação de oito episódios do cineasta de terror Mike Flanagan, que reinterpreta a história clássica do autor Stephen King para o público moderno por meio das redes sociais, do cyberbullying e dos simulados de ataque com atirador ativo.
item.dc:creator: Meriam Telhig
item.content:encoded: “Carrie” retorna nesta semana em uma nova adaptação de oito episódios do cineasta de terror Mike Flanagan, que reinterpreta a história clássica do autor Stephen King para o público moderno por meio das redes sociais, do cyberbullying e dos simulados de ataque com atirador ativo. Em entrevista à Reuters, Flanagan disse que nunca imaginou revisitar “Carrie”, mas sua perspectiva mudou quando seu filho estava se preparando para entrar no ensino médio. “Havia tantas ideias em ‘Carrie’ que parecem ainda mais relevantes hoje do que há meio século, quando o livro foi escrito”, disse Flanagan. “Achei que poderíamos fazer algo realmente novo com isso.” A série acompanha uma adolescente socialmente isolada que luta para se integrar no ensino médio enquanto lida com um relacionamento complicado com sua mãe superprotetora, interpretada por Samantha Sloyan. A adaptação atualiza o romance de King, de 1974, com questões enfrentadas pelos adolescentes de agora. Summer H. Howell, que interpreta Carrie White, disse que, a princípio, ficou intimidada ao assumir um papel tão icônico, mas que a oportunidade de explorar a personagem ao longo de oito episódios a atraiu. “Foi um pouco intimidador”, disse Howell. “Mas então percebi que eles estavam buscando algo diferente com essa Carrie, e que havia mais tempo para explorar a história dela.” Matthew Lillard, que interpreta o diretor Henry Grayle, disse que os temas da série ressoaram nele como pai, devido ao assédio online e às pressões que os adolescentes enfrentam. “Meus filhos estão sujeitos aos horríveis trolls que vivem nas trevas da internet”, disse Lillard. Alison Thornton, que interpreta a antagonista de Carrie, Chris Hargensen, disse que as redes sociais mudaram a natureza do bullying. “As pessoas se sentem muito mais à vontade para praticar bullying online do que pessoalmente”, disse Thornton. “Elas não precisam realmente enfrentar as consequências.” Flanagan disse que queria que cada personagem de “Carrie” parecesse real e complexo, ao mesmo tempo em que explorava as escolhas que as pessoas fazem entre crueldade e bondade. Sloyan disse que a série também destaca a responsabilidade pessoal. “Também acho que ele está colocando em destaque o fato de que temos escolha e que existe uma autonomia que podemos exercer nesse contexto”, disse ela, acrescentando que a série explora “a humanidade envolvida”. Howell disse que a série, no fim das contas, transmite uma mensagem simples: “Sejam gentis uns com os outros, mesmo quando vocês mesmos não estiverem se sentindo bem”. “Carrie” estará disponível globalmente no Amazon Prime Video a partir de quarta-feira.

item.title: Governo reduz a US$84,4 bi projeção de superávit comercial em 2026 apesar de dado forte em setembro
item.description: O Ministério do Desenvolvimento, Indústria, Comércio e Serviços (MDIC) reduziu nesta terça-feira sua projeção para o superávit da balança comercial brasileira em 2026 a US$84,4 bilhões, contra previsão feita em julho de saldo de US$90,0 bilhões, prevendo ganho menor nas exportações com o arrefecimento de preços internacionais.
item.dc:creator: Bernardo Caram
item.content:encoded: O Ministério do Desenvolvimento, Indústria, Comércio e Serviços (MDIC) reduziu nesta terça-feira sua projeção para o superávit da balança comercial brasileira em 2026 a US$84,4 bilhões, contra previsão feita em julho de saldo de US$90,0 bilhões, prevendo ganho menor nas exportações com o arrefecimento de preços internacionais. Apesar da revisão para baixo, o resultado ainda seria 24% mais forte do que o observado no ano anterior, quando o saldo foi de US$68,1 bilhões, e marcaria o segundo maior saldo da série histórica, atrás apenas do dado de 2023. Pelos cálculos do MDIC, as exportações devem fechar o ano em US$382,5 bilhões, uma redução de US$11,9 bilhões em relação à estimativa de julho, mas ainda representando um recorde histórico. As importações ficariam em US$298,1 bilhões, um recuo de US$6,3 bilhões sobre a previsão anterior. O diretor de Estatísticas e Estudos de Comércio Exterior do MDIC, Herlon Brandão, afirmou que a projeção feita em julho refletia forte alta dos preços do petróleo e de outros produtos diante da guerra no Irã, o que ampliaria o resultado das exportações. A partir do meio do ano, segundo ele, parte desses preços registrou alguma acomodação, o que reflete na nova projeção. “Esse movimento arrefeceu e resultou em uma taxa de crescimento (das exportações) ainda significativa, mas um pouco menor do que o modelo estava captando no primeiro semestre”, disse. DADOS DE SETEMBRO O MDIC apontou que a balança comercial brasileira registrou em setembro um superávit de US$7,741 bilhões, um crescimento de 146% na comparação com o resultado do mesmo mês de 2025 e melhor do que o esperado pelo mercado, que previa em pesquisa da Reuters um saldo positivo de US$7,191 bilhões. (BRTBAL=ECI) O desempenho do mês é fruto de US$34,418 bilhões em exportações, uma alta de 12,9% na comparação com o mesmo mês de 2025, e US$26,678 bilhões em importações, recuo de 2,4%. No período, houve aumento das exportações em todos os setores, com destaque para uma alta de 39,8% na indústria extrativa, seguida de crescimentos de 5,3% na indústria de transformação e de 4,8% na agropecuária. Entre os destaques estão os embarques de óleos brutos de petróleo, com crescimento de 77% no período, de soja, com alta de 12%, e óleos combustíveis de petróleo, com alta de 39%. No sentido contrário, houve redução de quase 31% nas vendas de carne bovina. Em setembro, as exportações aos Estados Unidos cresceram 32%, apesar da vigência do tarifaço, que atinge 23% da pauta de produtos vendidos, segundo Brandão. Ele ressaltou altas de 524% nas vendas de carne e de 108% nos embarques de café para o país norte-americano, produtos que eram taxados em setembro do ano passado e estão agora isentos de tarifas. Para a China, houve recuo de 7,6% nas exportações no mês, diante de tarifação das vendas de carne bovina após o atingimento de cota, mas também por uma redução na demanda do país, segundo Brandão, que impactou as vendas de minério de ferro, soja e milho. Do lado das importações, houve queda mais intensa nas compras bens de capital, um recuo de 30% motivado pela importação de plataforma de petróleo em setembro de 2025, que distorceu a base de comparação com o mês passado. Houve ainda queda de 2,4% nas importações de bens intermediários, enquanto foram registradas altas de 11,5% em bens de consumo e de 41,2% em combustíveis. Nos primeiros nove meses do ano, o país acumulou um superávit comercial de US$62,396 bilhões, 35% acima do saldo positivo de US$46,300 bilhões do mesmo período de 2025.

item.title: 米追加利上げの是非、インフレ押し上げショックの展開次第＝ＳＦ連銀総裁
item.description: [６日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は６日、今後の追加利上げの是非について、インフレを押し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米追加利上げの是非、インフレ押し上げショックの展開次第＝ＳＦ連銀総裁 3:03 配信

米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁。同地区連銀ビルで４月撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria

[６日　ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は６日、今後の追加利上げの是非について、インフレを押し上げてきたショックが収束に向かうのか、逆にショックが相互に重なり合って持続するのかに大きく左右されるとの考えを示した。

デイリー総裁はアクシオスとのインタビューで、９月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）ではインフレリスクの高まりを受けて利上げを支持したと説明。その上で「われわれが経験してきたショック、つまり関税措置、中東紛争に伴う原油価格の急騰、そしてＡＩ（人工知能）が一時的な影響しか及ぼさない従来型のショックであると判明すれば、追加利上げは不要かもしれない。私は依然としてその可能性を一定程度想定している」と語った。

さらに「ただ、これらのショックが互いに相乗効果を生むか、あるいはわれわれの予想より長引くのであれば、もし第２弾の関税交渉が行われてさらなる関税が課されれば、最初のショックに第２のショックが重なることになる。そうなればこれらのショックが影響を及ぼす期間が長引くことになるだろう」と述べた。

デイリー氏は、ＡＩ関連の半導体需要が高まっており、これがインフレ圧力を押し上げ、ショックの影響をより長期化させる可能性があるとの見方も示した。

同総裁は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権は持っていない。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か 最終更新: 10/7(水) 3:03 ロイター

item.title: Yemeni government fighters shown driving vehicles over Houthi opponents
item.description: Video posted by government forces in Yemen showed them driving armoured cars over Houthi fighters as they recaptured areas around the vital Bab el-Mandeb Strait from the Iran-backed group on Monday in a deadly new phase of the fragmented country's war.
item.dc:creator: Edward Carron
item.content:encoded: Video posted by government forces in Yemen showed them driving armoured cars over Houthi fighters as they recaptured areas around the vital [USN:L8N4520BL TEXT:"Bab el-Mandeb Strait"] from the Iran-backed group on Monday in a deadly new phase of the fragmented country's war. The videos gave a glimpse into the brutal closing stages of a pitched battle for control of territory near the strait that the Houthis had captured last month. The Houthi advance sent shockwaves through the oil market and pushed up petrol and diesel prices worldwide. Fighting continued near Bab el-Mandeb on Tuesday as Saudi-backed government forces battled to consolidate [USN:L1N45R06H TEXT:"Monday's counter-attack"], besieging Houthi fighters at a military camp near the strait and pushing into hills to the east, Yemeni military sources said. The videos, verified by Reuters and filmed from inside the armoured vehicles, showed them striking fighters with their vehicles. Some were armed and some were walking or running. However, others were unarmed and some were sitting, lying or crouching on the sandy shore and made no move to evade the oncoming vehicle as they were run over. At one point, a vehicle hits a man, running and unarmed, and another crouching on the ground. It then loops back to drive over two men, both with their hands up and unarmed. Shooting can be heard during the video and at one point the vehicle's windscreen is cracked by a gunshot. A Houthi statement decried the videos as proof of war crimes, saying they showed "the true nature of the Saudi regime and the forces it has mobilised from extremist factions". Asil al-Saqladi, spokesperson for the Giants Brigade — the main Yemeni government force involved in the fighting at Bab el-Mandeb this week — said the force was conducting an investigation into the incident. He added that the brigade had been misled into believing that the Houthi fighters there were surrendering but that some of them had then fired on the government force. The Saudi-led coalition backing the government forces in Yemen did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the videos or the Houthi accusations of war crimes. The Homeland Shield Forces, a significant formation in the Yemeni government's military coalition, did not comment directly on the videos but issued a directive on Tuesday urging troops to treat prisoners well and adhere to religious, ethical and legal standards. Rights groups have previously accused the Houthis of war crimes, including sniper and shelling attacks on civilian targets, seizures of aid, abuse of prisoners and use of child soldiers. The group has denied war crimes. 'TURNING POINT' Reuters has not been able to independently verify the extent of government gains and the Houthis denied they had lost ground, saying the government claims of advances were baseless. Intense fighting meanwhile continued around Yemen's third-largest city of Taiz, where Houthi gains in a mountain district have in recent days cut off a main road to Aden, leaving government forces encircled. Yemen's [USN:L6N3Y307N TEXT:"civil war"] pits the Houthis against an uneasy coalition of sometimes rival military forces under the internationally recognised government, backed by Saudi Arabia and its allies. The renewed clashes have added a new front to the Iran-US conflict , with the [USN:L6N45308G TEXT:"US rebuffing"] Saudi requests for military help to reverse Houthi gains on the Red Sea coast near Bab el-Mandeb last month and end the group's missile and drone attacks on their territory. "The operation itself is significant because it's a turning point in the trajectory of the conflict between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition," said Ahmed Nagi, Yemen analyst at International Crisis Group. "The biggest test will be when they move towards the mountains," he added. RELIGIOUS AND REGIONAL FAULTLINES The Giants Brigade is a southern military formation originally formed by students at ultra-conservative Sunni Muslim religious colleges. That background gives both a religious and regional edge to their enmity with the Houthis, who originate in north Yemen and belong to the Zaydi school of Shi'ite Islam. The Giants have themselves fractured this year, splitting between factions backed by Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, illustrating the internal divisions that have long beset the Yemeni government's efforts to fight the Houthis. As well as further squeezing global trade routes after Iran's disruption of shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, the conflagration in Yemen has brought the conflict more directly to Saudi Arabia, a US ally. The Houthis have repeatedly targeted Saudi infrastructure, including airports, oil refineries and pipelines. Residents of the Saudi capital Riyadh reported hearing booms overnight and two of the kingdom's [USN:L1N45S0BG TEXT:"southern airports"] were targeted. Saudi Arabia's intervention in the latest wave of fighting included intense air strikes on Houthi forces on Monday as the Giants Brigade advanced along the flat coastal strip towards Bab el-Mandeb.

item.title: MetLife y CNP muestran interés en negocios de Prudential en Brasil y México por US$3.000 millones
item.description: Prudential busca obtener US$3.000 millones por las operaciones de Brasil y México en conjunto, con Brasil representando casi el 90% del paquete, según fuentes.
item.dc:creator: Cristiane Lucchesi, Matheus Piovesana, Alex Rajbhandari
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los negocios de Prudential Financial Inc. en Brasil y México han atraído el interés de MetLife Inc. y CNP Assurances SA en una operación que podría reportar unos US$3.000 millones a Prudential, según fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto. Mapfre SA también mostró interés anteriormente, pero no está claro si presentará una oferta, indicaron las fuentes, que pidieron no ser identificadas porque se trata de información privada. Daiichi Life Group Inc. decidió por ahora no presentar una oferta, agregaron. Ver más: Banco Mundial se alinea con pronósticos para el crecimiento de México en 2026 Se espera que la transacción se anuncie este año, aunque las condiciones y los posibles compradores aún podrían cambiar, según las fuentes. Prudential busca obtener US$3.000 millones por las operaciones de Brasil y México en conjunto, con Brasil representando casi el 90% del paquete, según las fuentes. Representantes de Prudential, MetLife, CNP, Daiichi y Mapfre declinaron hacer comentarios. Prudential vende seguros de vida en Brasil y se encuentra entre las mayores aseguradoras del país, con 4.880 millones de reales (US$977 millones) en primas entre enero y julio, según datos del regulador Susep. Cualquier comprador probablemente tendrá que lidiar con demandas laborales pendientes contra Prudential en Brasil, según una de las fuentes. La empresa busca revertir las provisiones vinculadas a esas demandas para pagar un dividendo a su matriz antes del cierre de la operación. Algunos posibles compradores, sin embargo, quieren descontar esas provisiones del precio. Prudential tenía casi 193 millones de reales provisionados por demandas laborales en junio de 2026, según sus estados financieros. Prudential, con sede en Newark, Nueva Jersey, busca simplificar sus operaciones mediante la venta de activos en mercados emergentes. El director ejecutivo, Andy Sullivan, pretende reducir la presencia de la compañía y reasignar recursos hacia negocios menos intensivos en capital para impulsar las ganancias. La directora financiera, Yanela Frias, dijo el mes pasado que la venta de las unidades de Brasil y México estaba “muy avanzada”. Lee más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: ロシアが「大規模攻撃」準備、防衛支援巡る各国対応重要＝ゼレンスキー氏
item.description: [６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[６日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は６日、最新の情報分析で、ロシアがウクライナに対する「大規模な攻撃」を準備していることが示されていると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は恒例の夜のビデオ演説で「ロシアが大規模な攻撃を準備していることが最新の情報分析で示されている」と述べた。その上で「ウクライナの情報機関と空軍は利用可能な防空手段が許す限りの対応する用意ができている」とし、ウクライナが必要とする防衛能力を保有し、それを提供できる各国首脳の対応が極めて重要になっているとの認識を示した。

Oct 6 : U.S. Ryder Cup captain Jim Furyk conceded on Tuesday that his team's dismal foursomes record was "not an anomaly" and promised changes ahead of next year's competition at Adare Manor where they will try to deny Europe a third consecutive victory. The U.S. have won only three of 16 foursomes matches across the last two editions of the biennial Ryder Cup and also struggled in the same format at the last two Presidents Cups where they went 5-13-0 against a lineup of international players from outside Europe. "There's some issues. We understand that. Not something I'm very happy with," Furyk, speaking alongside Team Europe captain Luke Donald, said during a press conference at Adare Manor in Limerick, Ireland. "I plan on making some changes." Furyk, who was named captain of the US team in April after Tiger Woods declined the role following his arrest on a driving-under-the-influence charge, has already implemented a revamped qualification system for the 2027 matches and counts a new analytics team among the changes he hopes will lead to success in foursomes.

Still, his squad will face a tall order at Adare Manor given the US have not won a Ryder Cup on European soil since 1993 at The Belfry in Warwickshire. "I will promise you, we will be prepared. I'm going to ask this team to do more than any other United States team has in the past," said Furyk. "We'll be prepared. We'll be ready to go in that format, and hopefully we can showcase our talent. We have too much depth to have that poor record in alternate shot." US Presidents Cup captain Brandt Snedeker fired an early battle cry after his players delivered the most lopsided singles session in that event's history, boasting after the 17-13 triumph that the American team is "going to be a problem" for Europe at the next Ryder Cup. Donald, who next year will aim to become the first captain to guide a team to three straight Ryder Cup victories, was not about to disagree. "I have zero complacency about how strong the US are going to be. They always are. On paper, they tend to be stronger than us through the world rankings," said Donald. "Obviously we have a great record at home but again, zero complacency. You know, I've seen what Jim has been doing behind the scenes, changing the stats, changing the qualification system. He is very, very motivated to come here and put up a good fight."

Source: Reuters

item.title: All-Star pitcher 'Sudden Sam' McDowell dies at 84
item.description: Six-time All-Star pitcher Sam McDowell, who played 15 seasons in the majors with four teams, died Monday at the age of 84.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Six-time All-Star pitcher Sam McDowell, who played 15 seasons in the majors with four teams, died Monday at the age of 84. McDowell, a left-hander nicknamed "Sudden Sam" for his brilliant fastball, spent his first 11 seasons in Cleveland from 1961-71. He led the American League in strikeouts five times during that span, including two seasons with more than 300, and topped the league in ERA once. "The Cleveland Guardians family is deeply saddened by the loss of one of the great pitchers in baseball history, Sam McDowell," Bob DiBiasio, the Guardians' senior vice president of public affairs, said in a press release Tuesday. "He was a cherished member of our Alumni Ambassador program and loved sharing stories with our fans when he visited Progressive Field," DiBiasio continued. "Most importantly, Sam's life was a story of redemption. After extensive education and training, Sam was a counselor for athletes suffering from addiction and depression. We send our condolences to the entire McDowell family, as well as his many teammates and other organizations impacted by his career." A Pittsburgh native, McDowell compiled a record of 141-134 with 14 saves and a 3.17 ERA in 425 career games (346 starts) with Cleveland, the San Francisco Giants (1972-73), New York Yankees (1973-74) and his hometown Pirates (1975). McDowell finished third in the AL Cy Young Award voting in 1970 after finishing 20-12 with a 2.92 ERA and 304 strikeouts in 305 innings. He racked up 2,159 of his 2,453 strikeouts with Cleveland, joining Hall of Famer Bob Feller (2,581) as the only pitchers in team history with more than 2,000. --Field Level Media

item.title: Nvidia-backed Lambda targets $4 billion raise ahead of planned IPO, WSJ reports
item.description: Nvidia-backed cloud-computing company Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a pre-money valuation of $14.5 billion in what would be its final funding round before a planned initial public offering, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia-backed cloud-computing company Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a pre-money valuation of $14.5 billion in what would be its final funding round before a planned initial public offering, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter. Here are more details: Investment firms Blackstone (BX.N) and Coatue Management are leading the round, the report said. Lambda is aiming to go public in 2027, depending on execution and market conditions, according to a letter to the company's limited partners reviewed by the Journal. The company's backlog of unfilled orders grew to $50 billion in September from $15 billion in June, according to the letter. Lambda did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

item.title: US agency to rewrite rules to address vehicle headlight glare
item.description: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said on Tuesday that it will rewrite its vehicle lighting standards to address concerns about headlight glare and allow for the latest safety-improving lighting technologies.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said on Tuesday that it will rewrite its vehicle lighting standards to address concerns about headlight glare and allow for the latest safety-improving lighting technologies. NHTSA said it plans to improve rules for LEDs, dusk sensors, automatic high beams and replaceable light sources. The agency will also evaluate headlamp height and aim and how they impact driver visibility and address headlight glare and make appropriate changes. Complaints about glare from headlights have increased and some lawmakers have urged the government to set a maximum headlight brightness standard. A growing number of taller trucks and SUVs on roads has also led to more complaints about glare. LEDs, which now account for most headlights in new cars, are much brighter than traditional halogen headlights. “Today’s standards do not allow automakers to deploy the latest safety-improving lighting technologies, so we are bringing key experts and stakeholders together to modernize our standards and address potential causes of glare," said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison. The issue still accounts for a small number of nighttime crashes, according to a study last year from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety. The study noted that headlight glare contributes to far fewer crashes than insufficient visibility. From 2015 to 2023, headlight glare was cited as a factor in only one or two out of every 1,000 nighttime crashes across 11 US states, the study shows. Federal headlight standards for minimum and maximum brightness have not changed since 1997, IIHS noted. The study found that drivers older than 70 appear to be most affected by headlight glare. In 2022, NHTSA said it would allow automakers to install adaptive driving beam headlights on new vehicles. The devices adjust the headlight beam pattern to dim portions directed at other vehicles. NHTSA will use a negotiated rulemaking process to update its vehicle lighting standards. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy will appoint up to 18 people from vehicle lighting manufacturers, motor vehicle equipment associations, safety organizations, research institutions, and engineering associations to take part.

Oct 6 : Captain Shreyas Iyer hit a century as India beat the West Indies by eight wickets in the first Twenty20 of their five-match series in Lucknow on Tuesday. Iyer led the chase with an unbeaten 102 off 43 deliveries, hitting 10 fours and six sixes, as India cruised to victory with 32 balls to spare. Abhishek Sharma provided an early burst before Roston Chase dismissed him for 21 off 10 balls. Sanju Samson departed soon after, leaving India at 35 for two. Iyer and Ishan Kishan then wrested control of the chase, combining in an unbroken 137-run partnership off 67 deliveries to seal victory for India.

Opener Shai Hope rebuilt the innings with Sherfane Rutherford in a 63-run fourth-wicket stand before Naman Dhir dismissed captain Hope for 52 off 37 balls. item.title: OpenAI in talks with UAE funds, BlackRock for $30 billion funding round
item.description: UAE investment funds have discussed investing as much as $10 billion altogether, while OpenAI is seeking capital at a valuation of about $1.4 trillion ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: By Ed Ludlow, Rebecca Torrence, Shirin Ghaffary and Natasha Mascarenhas OpenAI is in talks with multiple investment funds from the United Arab Emirates, including Abu Dhabi-based MGX, to help anchor a $30 billion round of financing for the ChatGPT maker, according to people familiar with the matter. The funds would form a syndicate to invest in the round, one of the people said. The UAE funds have discussed putting in as much as $10 billion altogether, one person said. BlackRock Inc. is also in discussions to participate in the round alongside that syndicate, the people said. The fundraise is ongoing and the details could change, said the people, requesting anonymity to discuss private information. OpenAI and BlackRock declined to comment. Representatives for MGX did not respond to requests for comment outside normal business hours. OpenAI is looking to raise at least $30 billion in capital at a valuation of about $1.4 trillion, Bloomberg News has reported, as the firm pushes back plans for an initial public offering until at least next year, citing its focus on AI safety efforts. OpenAI most recently raised a $122 billion round in March at an $852 billion valuation, including the money. Top AI firms, including OpenAI and Anthropic PBC, have previously turned to deep-pocketed investors in the Middle East to meet their intense capital needs to develop and support cutting-edge artificial intelligence software. MGX has invested in prior OpenAI and Anthropic rounds. The investment firm raised close to $50 billion earlier this year to accelerate spending on AI infrastructure and technology, Bloomberg News has reported. OpenAI has held talks with the University of California’s endowment fund, an existing investor, about participating in the round, the people said. Existing backers Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz have also discussed putting in money, the people said. Thrive declined to comment. Representatives for Andreessen and the University of California didn’t respond to requests for comment. Unlike typical venture rounds, OpenAI is presenting its $1.4 trillion pre-money valuation to investors as a set price despite not yet settling on a lead investor, the people said. Normally, investment firms submit terms for funding rounds and negotiate with the company about leading it. --With assistance from Alex Dooler

item.title: Precios de bonos del Tesoro de EEUU suben en un respiro tras desplome; subasta mejora la confianza
item.description: Los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos se recuperaron el martes de una ola de ventas de la víspera que llevó los retornos a largo plazo a máximos de varias décadas, porque los inversores se tomaron un respiro para evaluar los movimientos recientes a la espera de los datos de inflación de la próxima semana.
item.dc:creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
item.content:encoded: Los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos se recuperaron el martes de una ola de ventas de la víspera que llevó los retornos a largo plazo a máximos de varias décadas, porque los inversores se tomaron un respiro para evaluar los movimientos recientes a la espera de los datos de inflación de la próxima semana. Una sólida subasta de bonos a tres años también contribuyó al impulso alcista de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos. El rendimiento de referencia a 10 años cayó 4,2 puntos básicos, al 5,269%, tras alcanzar un máximo de 24 años. Los retornos a 30 años bajaron 2,2 puntos básicos, al 5,642%, tras otro máximo de 24 años del lunes. En el extremo más corto de la curva, la rentabilidad a 2 años , sensible a las perspectivas de las tasas de interés, cayó 4,4 puntos básicos al 4,789% . La caída de los rendimientos implica que los precios de los bonos del Tesoro suben. "Creo que los operadores están tomando aliento antes de que cambie algo en los fundamentos", dijo Will Compernolle, estratega macroeconómico de FHN Financial en Chicago. "Los operadores también están a la espera de ver cuál será el próximo gran catalizador, y no sé si vendrá de la mano del IPP (índice de precios al productor) o del IPC (índice de precios al consumidor)" . Analistas señalaron además que los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos encontraron apoyo tras un repunte similar en los bonos de la zona del euro, especialmente los franceses. Los costos de financiación de Francia se han disparado en las últimas semanas y el diferencial de rendimiento respecto a Alemania se amplió el viernes hasta su nivel más alto desde la crisis de la deuda de la zona euro en 2011. El repunte de las tasas ocurrió en un contexto de preocupación por el deterioro de la situación fiscal del país antes de las elecciones presidenciales del próximo año. La curva de rendimientos se aplanó el martes, y el diferencial entre las tasas a dos y 10 años se reducía a 47,8 puntos básicos desde los 48,9 puntos básicos del lunes. La curva había alcanzado el lunes su nivel más pronunciado en siete semanas, después de que los retornos a largo plazo subieron con mayor intensidad que los de plazo más corto.

item.title: 米中ロ首脳会談に関心、 11月ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議で ＝ロシア大統領補佐官
item.description: [モスクワ ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ　６日　ロイター] - ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官は６日、中国で１１月に開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせ、プーチン大統領、トランプ米大統領、中国の習近平国家主席による３者会談が実現する可能性について、ロシアとして関心を持っていると述べた。

ウシャコフ氏は、この構想は初期段階にあり、詳細はまだ調整されていないとした上で、ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議の議長国を務める中国が今後議題を提示するとし、３カ国首脳による会談の機会が設けられる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議は１１月１８─１９日に開かれる。

ウシャコフ氏はこのほか、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領が９日にトルクメニスタンで開かれる旧ソ連諸国首脳会議に出席し、その際にプーチン大統領と会談すると明らかにした。

item.title: South Korea exports eased Russia fuel crisis caused by drone strikes, Ukraine says
item.description: LONDON/SEOUL, Oct 6 : Russia imported more than 176,000 tons of petroleum products from South Korean ports in July and August, easing the impact of a fuel crisis caused by Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries, Ukraine's top sanctions official said on Tuesday.The supplies from South Korea made up

South Korea exports eased Russia fuel crisis caused by drone strikes, Ukraine says

LONDON/SEOUL, Oct 6 : Russia imported more than 176,000 tons of petroleum products from South Korean ports in July and August, easing the impact of a fuel crisis caused by Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries, Ukraine's top sanctions official said on Tuesday. The supplies from South Korea made up 31 per cent of Russian fuel imports in August, according to the official, Vladyslav Vlasiuk, citing what he said were reports that tankers, including ones under Western sanctions, were used for the deliveries. "These shipments began precisely when Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries were reducing processing volumes and creating a fuel shortage within Russia," Vlasiuk, presidential commissioner for Ukrainian sanctions policy, wrote on Facebook. His comments come amid a diplomatic row between Seoul and Kyiv that erupted last month when President Volodymyr Zelenskiy announced the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea, a step that Seoul says was meant to stay secret.

Ukraine has used long-range drones to attack Russian oil refineries and depots this year in what Kyiv has described as an effort to impose greater costs on its enemy, with no end in sight more than four years since Russia's full-scale invasion. The strikes prompted Russia to impose a ban on diesel and gasoline exports, while restricting fuel purchases in some regions hit hard by the fuel crunch. "In effect, imports from South Korea helped Russia offset the impact of losing its own refining capacity," Vlasiuk said, citing "available data" and "reports" as sources in his post. Earlier on Tuesday, the Guardian reported that it had analysed port records and ship-tracking data, determining that the volumes were loaded at South Korean ports onto seven tankers, some of which are under UK and EU sanctions. Vlasiuk provided the same figures as those in the Guardian. "This stands in stark contrast to the sanctions policy South Korea adopted following the start of the full-scale invasion," Vlasiuk said. In response to the Guardian article, South Korea's Foreign Ministry said "the Korean government supports and actively participates in global efforts to end the war in Ukraine and achieve peaceful recovery". It said that its government was strictly enforcing export controls against Russia by expanding the scope beyond strategic items to include "non-strategic items ... that carry a high risk of diversion for military use." Relations between South Korea and Ukraine have been under strain for weeks. South Korean President Lee Jae Myung threatened unspecified measures against Ukraine on Friday unless Kyiv acknowledged a confidentiality agreement that Seoul says covered the transfer of two captured North Korean soldiers. Seoul has said it wants an apology. Ukraine denies there was a confidentiality agreement, but its foreign minister has said that Kyiv wants to mend ties with South Korea.

Source: Reuters

item.title: リトアニア、核兵器禁止条項撤廃へ 議会で第1回採決通過
item.description: ［ビリニュス ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ビリニュス　６日　ロイター］ - リトアニア議会は６日、核兵器を禁じる憲法の条項撤廃提案について、１回目の投票で可決した。議員１４１のうち１０６人が賛成票を投じ、可決に必要な３分の２以上の賛成を確保した。条項撤廃には２回目の投票でも３分の２以上の賛成が必要となり、来年１月１２日に採決が予定されている。

禁止条項はリトアニアが旧ソ連から独立して以降、３０年以上維持されてきた。ロシアによるウクライナへの全面侵攻などを経て、バルト３国などの安全保障上の前提が変化していることが示された形となった。

リトアニアのナウセーダ大統領は、国内に核兵器を配備する計画は当面ないものの、条項撤廃により安全保障環境が変化した場合には対応できるようになると説明。各党が禁止条項の撤廃案で合意したと述べていた。ナウセーダ氏は７月、リトアニアが引き続き核拡散防止条約（ＮＰＴ）の締約国にとどまることも表明している。

item.title: 仏、最新弾道ミサイル初試験発射 ロシアとの緊張で核抑止力向上
item.description:
John Irish
［パリ ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
John Irish

［パリ　６日　ロイター］ - フランス国防省は６日、最新の潜水艦発射弾道ミサイル「Ｍ５１．３」の初めての発射試験を行ったと発表した。２０２５年１０月に配備され、射程は９０００キロ以上と推定されている。ロシアとの緊張が高まる中、核戦力を近代化することで抑止力を向上する戦略の一環となる。

マクロン大統領は「われわれがより強くなったというメッセージが明確に伝えられた」と、発射を見守る自身の動画と共にＸに投稿した。弾道ミサイルは、整備を終了した原子力潜水艦の能力を確認する作戦の一部としてブルターニュ沖から発射された。国防省は国際法を順守して実施したと説明している。

ロシアのプーチン大統領は先週、西側諸国に対し、ウクライナを巡る対立を深めないよう警告。ポーランドとリトアニアに挟まれたロシアの飛び地カリーニングラードを防衛するため、必要であれば核兵器を用いる意向を明らかにした。北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）は「いかなる活動も、ロシアの領土への脅威とはならない」と主張。プーチン氏も、欧州諸国を攻撃する計画はないとの意向を示している。

マクロン氏は今年３月、核搭載可能な兵器の欧州同盟国への配備や、共同演習を実施する構想を打ち出した。フランスは、世界第４位の核弾頭２９０発を維持するため、年約５６億ユーロ（約６０億４０００万ドル）を支出。ロシアと米国はそれぞれ５０００発超、英国は２２５発を保有している。

FAST

Oct 6 : Three-times Olympic champion Mikaela Shiffrin intends to race less slalom next season, and concentrate more on giant slalom and super-G, with the American describing the new campaign as "an exploration". Shiffrin won her second Olympic slalom gold medal at Milano Cortina this year and has dominated the discipline at World Cup level, winning the slalom crystal globe on nine occasions. The 31-year-old holds the record for most World Cup race wins, with 73 of her 110 victories coming in slalom. Shiffrin says that curiosity has been the driving force behind her motivation down through the years.

"Right now, I feel that curiosity with giant slalom and super-G. This season is an exploration." Shiffrin said on social media on Tuesday. "I'm planning to race less slalom this season. Not necessarily no slalom." Shiffrin, who won nine of the 10 slalom races last season, will skip the first two slalom events in the new season. "Right now, the plan is Killington as my first slalom and potentially a few others throughout the season," Shiffrin said. "I'll have the chance to recover, train differently, take care of my body differently, and build more intentional GS and super-G blocks." INTENT TO CHANGE In February, Shiffrin signalled her intent to make a change when she spoke to Reuters following her Olympic success. "I feel that there's some kind of transition in my career coming closer," Shiffrin said. "But I don't know what that looks like and I don't know how to say it." After winning a record-equalling sixth World Cup overall crystal globe last season, the transition is also about putting off the day when she hangs up her skis. "Ironically, the more predictable choice might be to race only slalom. From a purely results-oriented perspective, maybe that's the obvious move," Shiffrin said. "But staying only where I've been most successful, rather than taking a risk and following my curiosity into something less known, feels like a faster path toward retirement." Shiffrin has won the giant slalom globe twice, and her only super-G success came in 2019, in her best ever season when she also won the slalom, giant slalom overall titles. The season begins with a giant slalom on October 24 in Solden, Austria.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Thousands of European wind and solar power systems exposed online, Dutch researchers say
item.description: Thousands of administrative systems at wind and solar power parks in Europe are exposed to the internet, potentially giving attackers access to interfaces that can stop turbines and raising the risk of sabotage, Dutch researchers warned on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Stephanie van den Berg, Toby Sterling
item.content:encoded: Thousands of administrative systems at wind and solar power parks in Europe are exposed to the internet, potentially giving attackers access to interfaces that can stop turbines and raising the risk of sabotage, Dutch researchers warned on Tuesday. The exposed systems included administrative and login interfaces as well as operational interfaces showing data and controls. However, one of the researchers, Soufian El Yadmani, from internet-scanning company Modat, told Reuters that researchers believed full control would have been possible in the case of around 181 sites. One turbine's web page showed live data, "Start, Stop and Reset" buttons and the turbine's location, the research said. Some systems controlled several turbines or a whole farm. "What we can map in hours, an attacker can map in hours too," the report said. The researchers urged operators to take admin interfaces off the internet immediately. SPANISH SOLAR, GERMAN WIND MOST EXPOSED The findings come amid [USN:L8N45F1L2 TEXT:"concerns about Europe's critical infrastructure,"] which has faced suspected sabotage and cyberattacks frequently attributed by Western governments to Russia since its invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Russia denies any involvement. Last month, Dutch intelligence agencies, police and prosecutors warned that artificial intelligence was accelerating the threat. El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem of the Dutch National Cyber Security Centre presented their findings on Tuesday at the ONE Conference in The Hague. Turbines or arrays closely linked to public infrastructure were a special concern, El Yadmani said. "If you can turn off the energy within the city or the airport, imagine that at a larger scale." Using machine learning to sort and cluster data, the pair said they identified 8,547 internet-facing systems they could link to at specific solar parks (7,942) and wind farms (605) in 35 European countries, which should not have been exposed to the internet. Most of the systems found were admin pages with login screens. Spain had the most exposed solar systems, with 2,766, followed by Greece with 1,860, they said. Germany has Europe's most installed solar capacity, and 672 exposed solar systems. However it had the most exposed wind systems with 212, with Italy close behind at 192. The researchers said the rankings partly reflected where they had been able to link systems to specific sites. The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity could not immediately comment. Authorities in Germany, Italy and Spain did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The report listed among its sources the Polish cybersecurity team CERT Polska's analysis of a [USN:L6N3YV10T TEXT:"December 2025 attack"] on 30 wind and solar sites in Poland, an example of the potential threat.

item.title: 米中、原子力施設の相互訪問を協議 信頼醸成へ前進の可能性＝報道
item.description: [６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[６日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権が中国と原子力施設の相互訪問の開始について協議しており、今後数カ月の対面会合で引き続きその実現を働きかけていく方針であることが分かった。協議は非公式かつ予備的な段階にある。ＣＮＮが６日、関係筋の話として報じた。

報道によると、相互訪問の構想は今年、米政府当局者との会合で中国側が最初に持ち出した。より大きな合意への道筋をつけ得る信頼醸成措置に、中国が前向きになる可能性を示唆する動きだとされる。関係筋によると、協議では米エネルギー省傘下の国立研究所と、中国側の同等施設への訪問が議論された。米国は核実験場への訪問についても議論する用意があるという。

原子力施設の相互訪問を認めるという構想は、戦略的安定性に関する問題で中国を関与させようとする米国の取り組みを前進させ、三国間協定の足掛かりとなる可能性があるが、中国は自国の核増強を制限しかねない協議には応じないとの姿勢を崩していないもよう。

item.title: Mayoría de monedas sube; activos brasileños se estabilizan tras dispararse en la víspera
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subió el martes por una baja global del dólar en medio del descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos y de los precios del crudo, que reducían los temores sobre la inflación, mientras que los activos brasileños se estabilizaron tras la fuerte alza de la víspera después de la primera vuelta presidencial.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subió el martes por una baja global del dólar en medio del descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos y de los precios del crudo, que reducían los temores sobre la inflación, mientras que los activos brasileños se estabilizaron tras la fuerte alza de la víspera después de la primera vuelta presidencial. * El índice dólar , que mide el desempeño del billete verde frente a una canasta de monedas pares, bajó un 0,32%, a 101,83 unidades, en su mayor caída diaria desde el 3 de septiembre. debido principalmente al avance del euro después de caer en la víspera a su mínimo de 17 meses. La moneda única avanzó ante el descenso de los retornos de los bonos franceses, que aliviaban los temores sobre la deuda de la zona euro. * La rentabilidad de la deuda de Estados Unidos también retrocedió, luego de tocar en la víspera máximos de varias décadas. Por su parte, los precios del crudo Brent bajaron levemente. * El real brasileño ganó un 0,55% a 4,9745 por dólar, su mayor cotización en casi cinco meses; al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) descendió un 0,53% a 205.805 puntos, al cierre preliminar, tras avanzar más temprano hasta un 1%, en medio de ajustes y con atención en las elecciones presidenciales. * En la víspera, el real escaló más de un 4% en su mayor avance diario desde el 8 de junio de 2018, mientras que el Bovespa se disparó hasta máximos históricos después del resultado de la primera vuelta electoral del domingo, cuando el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro llegó por sobre el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, en un desempeño que superó las proyecciones de las encuestas. * Flávio y Lula dirimirán la contienda presidencial en un balotaje el 25 de octubre. * El peso mexicano subía por la tarde un 0,58%, a 17,9682 unidades por dólar, marcando su tercer avance seguido; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, ganó un 0,45%, a 65.269,62 puntos, también en su tercera sesión consecutiva de alzas. * El peso chileno , subió un 0,19%, a 972,00/972,30 unidades por dólar, tras ceder parte importante de sus ganancias de primera hora. Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , clausuró la jornada con un alza 0,36%, en 11.163,42 puntos. * El peso colombiano , sin embargo, operó en contra de sus pares de la región y cerró con caída de un 1,30% a 3.241,50 unidades por dólar, luego de dos jornadas de ganancias; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) se valorizó un 0,24% a 2.588,91 puntos. * El peso mayorista argentino apenas avanzó un 0,03% a 1.520 por dólar, con la intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA) mediante la absorción de divisas para respaldar sus reservas internacionales. Este martes hubo compra oficial por 41 millones de dólares. El índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires ganó un 0,95%, ampliando el avance del 3,68% del lunes. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un leve 0,03% a 3,4340/3,4350 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) subía un leve 0,19% a 1.586,25 puntos.

item.title: Texas AG Paxton probes Fruit of the Loom, Hanes over potential toxic chemicals in children's underwear
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton launched an investigation on Tuesday into whether Fruit of the Loom and Hanes use toxic chemicals in producing children's underwear.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Stempel
item.content:encoded: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton launched an investigation on Tuesday into whether Fruit of the Loom and Hanes use toxic chemicals in producing children's underwear. Paxton said he sent civil investigative demands to Fruit of the Loom, which is owned by Berkshire Hathaway (BRKa.N) , and Hanes, which is owned by Gildan Activewear (GIL.TO) , citing the chemicals' potential effects on children's health. He did not accuse either company of wrongdoing. Fruit of the Loom and Berkshire did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Gildan said it will cooperate with the investigation, and maintains strict manufacturing and sourcing standards to comply with industry guidelines related to harmful chemicals. "We remain committed to providing safe, high-quality products for consumers," it added. Paxton said clothing manufacturers have turned increasingly to synthetic materials such as polyester, rayon and spandex to meet consumer demand for lower-priced products. He said research shows that synthetic fabrics can shed microplastics, while chemicals including bisphenols, fluorine, parabens, phthalates and so-called "forever chemicals" used in textile manufacturing have been associated with cancer, hormone disruption, infertility and other health concerns. "We must protect our children who cannot yet protect themselves," Paxton said in a statement. "This includes making sure that the necessities parents rely on are free from toxic chemicals and do not harm the health of kids." The attorney general announced a [USN:L6N40W10V TEXT:"similar probe"] in April into whether Lululemon Athletica (LULU.O) activewear contained forever chemicals, which do not break down easily in nature. Forever chemicals are also known as PFAS, short for per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances. Paxton, a Republican, is running for a US Senate seat against Democrat James Talarico and trailing in most polls. The race is among the country's most closely watched in the November 3 midterm elections.

item.title: パラマウント、1100億ドルのワーナー買収完了 新会社「スカイダンス」誕生
item.description:
Anzar Mehraj Harshita Mary Varghese
[６日 ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
巨大メディア「スカイダンス」誕生、パラマウントのワーナー買収完了 10/6 23:48 配信

米カリフォルニア州ロサンゼルスのパラマウント・スタジオで９月撮影。REUTERS/Daniel Cole

Anzar Mehraj　Harshita Mary Varghese

[６日　ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンスは６日、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー（ＷＢＤ）を買収する１１００億ドル規模の大型取引が完了したと発表した。これにより、新会社「スカイダンス」が誕生し、デービッド・エリソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が世界最大級のエンターテインメント企業を率いることになる。

統合後の新会社「スカイダンス」の株式は６日、ナスダックからニューヨーク証券取引所に移管され、「SKYD」のティッカーシンボルで取引が開始された。

人気映画シリーズ「ミッション：インポッシブル」や「ハリー・ポッター」などを手がけるスタジオに、ＣＢＳニュース、ＣＮＮニュース、「パラマウント＋（プラス）」、「ＨＢＯマックス」などの主要なテレビや動画配信サービスが統合され、映画、テレビ、ニュースを網羅する広範なエンターテインメント企業が誕生する。

トランプ米大統領は、記者団から買収完了について質問され、「素晴らしい企業になるだろう」とし、「素晴らしい合併だ」と応じた。

トランプ大統領は１期目から報道機関を批判し、最近ではＷＢＤ傘下のニュース専門局ＣＮＮを含む３社の記者らをホワイトハウスから締め出すという異例の措置を講じた。

５日発表された新会社の経営陣の詳細によると、ＣＮＮのマーク・トンプソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はＣＮＮの会長兼編集長として続投し、ＣＢＳニュースのバリ・ワイス編集長も現職にとどまる。これにより、ＣＮＮとＣＢＳはそれぞれ独立した編集体制を維持する見通しで、ＣＢＳのワイス氏が新会社全体のニュース部門を統括するとの懸念は後退した。

エリソンＣＥＯは、パラマウント傘下のＣＢＳニュースの報道内容をトランプ氏に有利なものにしようとしたとの批判を議員らから受けており、統合後の編集の独立性を巡る懸念が高まっていた。

また、新会社は約８００億ドルの負債を抱える見通しで、エリソン氏には配信事業の拡大、ケーブルネットワーク事業からのキャッシュフロー維持、劇場公開映画の業績改善が求められる。

調査会社モフェットナサンソンのアナリストは、同社の２０２８年の利払い・税引き・償却前利益（ＥＢＩＴＤＡ）を１６０億ドル、３０年には１９０億ドルに増加すると予想。売上高は２８年に約６７０億ドル、３０年には約７００億ドルに達すると見込む。

スカイダンスは、買収完了後の最初の２年間は年間少なくとも３０本、その後の３年間は年間３２本の映画を製作すると公約している。

エリソン氏は先週、統合後の新会社名を「スカイダンス」とした理由について、パラマウントとワーナー・ブラザースの両映画スタジオの個別のアイデンティティーが失われないようにすることが目的で、新たな企業ブランドの下に統合するものではないと説明していた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：武田薬のシャイアー買収5年、大型Ｍ＆Ａの難しさ示す コラム：ＡＩブームの恩恵受ける小型テック株、先行きは不透明 アングル：米株式取引24時間化、ウォール街では期待と慎重論が交錯 アングル：米株のテック依存、「ＩＴバブル期」上回る　市場を不安定に 焦点：過熱するＡＩ相場、収益化への懸念で市場に警戒感も 最終更新: 10/7(水) 6:09 ロイター

item.title: S&P 500 y Nasdaq alcanzan máximos récord de cierre, foco gira hacia ganancias corporativas
item.description: Wall Street cerró al alza el martes, ya que los precios del petróleo se estabilizaron y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro cedieron, ofreciendo cierto alivio ante las preocupaciones que habían inquietado a los inversores en las últimas semanas y permitiendo a los mercados centrar su atención en la próxima temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: Wall Street cerró al alza el martes, ya que los precios del petróleo se estabilizaron y los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro cedieron, ofreciendo cierto alivio ante las preocupaciones que habían inquietado a los inversores en las últimas semanas y permitiendo a los mercados centrar su atención en la próxima temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre. * Este avance generalizado llevó al S&P 500 y al Nasdaq a alcanzar máximos históricos de cierre. * Cuando los precios del petróleo se estabilizan o bajan, "eso provoca un descenso de los rendimientos porque disminuye la inquietud por la inflación impulsada por la energía, lo que a su vez ayuda a elevar las acciones", dijo Oliver Pursche, vicepresidente senior de Wealthspire Advisors en Nueva York. * El interés por el sector de la inteligencia artificial sigue muy vigente, con el índice de semiconductores Filadelfia (.SOX) ganando terreno. El gasto en infraestructura relacionada con la IA se reflejó en los datos de comercio internacional, que mostraron un aumento del 4,4% en las importaciones de bienes de capital durante agosto. * Un informe del Departamento de Comercio reveló que el déficit comercial de Estados Unidos creció un 13,7%, ante un incremento de las importaciones, a un máximo histórico. * En términos mensuales y anuales, las importaciones avanzaron un 4,3% y un 28,4%, respectivamente, reflejando una sólida demanda interna que podría agravar las presiones inflacionarias, sobre todo en medio de restricciones de suministro por el conflicto bélico. * Aun así, los mercados financieros descuentan actualmente una menor probabilidad de que la Reserva Federal aplique una segunda subida consecutiva de las tasas de interés en la reunión de política monetaria de este mes, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME. * Según los datos preliminares de cierre, el S&P 500 (.SPX) ganó 46,52 puntos, o un 0,60%, a 7.820,47 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) subió 127,43 puntos, o un 0,46%, a 27.604,74 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 263,67 puntos, o un 0,49%, a 51.531,57 unidades. * La temporada de resultados del tercer trimestre comienza la próxima semana, y se espera que varias firmas financieras de gran relevancia presenten sus informes el próximo martes. Los analistas prevén un crecimiento interanual agregado de los beneficios del S&P 500 del 30,6% para el periodo de julio a septiembre, según datos de LSEG.

Google fights £1 billion UK lawsuit over app store fees in latest Big Tech case

FILE PHOTO: The Google logo is seen outside the company's offices in London, Britain, June 24, 2025. REUTERS/Carlos Jasso/File Photo

FAST

LONDON, Oct 6 : Google was accused of abusing its dominance to levy excessive commissions on app developers, as a mass consumer lawsuit worth over £1 billion ($1.33 billion) began in London on Tuesday. The case — brought on behalf of around 20 million consumers who bought apps through Google's Play Store, or paid for in-app purchases and subscriptions between 2015 and this July — is the latest brought in Britain against Big Tech. Lawyers representing consumer advocate Liz Coll, who is leading the claim, say Google used its dominant position to charge commissions of up to 30 per cent on purchases of apps through its Play Store, as well as on in-app purchases and subscriptions. They argue that those excessive commissions were passed on by app developers to consumers, citing as an example that when Google sold YouTube Premium through Apple's App Store it also decided to pass on the commission it was charged.

But Google's parent Alphabet is fighting the lawsuit, which a spokesperson said ignores the degree of choice the Android platform gives consumers and that it charges "some of the lowest fees in the market". The tech giant's lawyers, who said Coll's case was unfounded, argued the Play Store "faces strong competitive constraints both on the developer and consumer sides", including from Apple's App Store and other alternative platforms. The trial at London's Competition Appeal Tribunal follows similar cases against Apple and Sony over their App Store and PlayStation Store, both of which cited commissions of up to 30 per cent. Coll's case also comes after years of regulatory scrutiny and litigation over Google's app store practices, including a long-running battle with "Fortnite" maker Epic Games, whose London lawsuit was due to be heard alongside Coll's. In March, Google and Epic reached a worldwide settlement under which Google said it would expand billing options and cut developer fees. Last month, Google also settled another lawsuit for £260 million, which was brought on behalf of app developers, without making any admission of liability or wrongdoing. ($1 = 0.7536 pounds)

Source: Reuters

item.title: Riesgo país de Argentina mantiene sesgo bajista por impulso de Brasil
item.description: El riesgo país de Argentina bajó el martes por segunda ronda consecutiva ante una mejora en los niveles de la deuda pública, tras el optimismo regional que representó el triunfo de la derecha en las recientes elecciones de Brasil.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El riesgo país de Argentina bajó el martes por segunda ronda consecutiva ante una mejora en los niveles de la deuda pública, tras el optimismo regional que representó el triunfo de la derecha en las recientes elecciones de Brasil. El senador Flávio Bolsonaro se enfrentará al mandatario Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en el balotaje de los comicios presidenciales de [USN:L1N45R01Q TEXT:"Brasil"], después de que el aspirante de derecha obtuviera cerca del 47% de los votos válidos en la primera vuelta del domingo, superando las previsiones de la mayoría de los sondeos. "A este resultado (en las urnas) no lo reflejaron la mayoría de las encuestas y por eso sorprendió, lo que aligeró el circulante de liquidez en toda la región. Pero hay que considerar que lo que puede ser bueno para los mercados, no necesariamente sea beneficioso para la marcha de la economía real", comentó un analista del Banco Galicia. La fuerte recuperación de los mercados financieros el lunes aún derramaba beneficios este martes, donde el riesgo país argentino elaborado por el J.P. Morgan caía a 574 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), desde las 600 unidades del cierre previo y los 655 puntos anotados el viernes pasado. Los bonos soberanos promediaban un fuerte salto positivo del 2%, desde la subida del 0,9% previa, mientras que el índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires ganó un 0,95% por coberturas rápidas, contra un salto del 3,68% del lunes. "El índice de tipo de cambio real multilateral de Argentina tiene a Brasil como su principal componente, con una ponderación del 20%", resaltó Rava Bursátil. "El secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, afirmó que volvería a apoyar financieramente a la Argentina en caso de ser necesario. Además, el equipo económico argentino declaró tener 15.000 millones de dólares para vender en futuros con vencimiento en 2027", agregó. El peso mayorista apenas avanzó un 0,03% a 1.520 por dólar , con la intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA) mediante la absorción de divisas para respaldar sus reservas internacionales. Este martes hubo compra oficial por 41 millones de dólares. Esta quietud cambiaria permite una mejora del peso en la competitividad regional por la subida del real brasileño tras las elecciones del domingo, dijeron operadores. Un reciente sondeo publicado por el portal Perfil indicó que siete de cada 10 empresarios participantes del coloquio anual de IDEA creen que el peso está sobrevaluado, ya que el nivel actual debería superar las 1.800 unidades por dólar.

item.title: ＩＭＦ、ヘッジファンドの存在感拡大 監視強化を要請
item.description:
Pete Schroeder
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は６日、ヘッジファンドは過去１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＩＭＦ、ヘッジファンドの存在感拡大　監視強化を要請 10/6 23:21 配信

米ワシントンにある国際通貨基金（IMF）本部前で2018年5月撮影。REUTERS/Yuri Gripas

Pete Schroeder

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は６日、ヘッジファンドは過去１０年あまりで資産規模が３倍以上に拡大し、現在では市場においてますます重要な役割を担っていると指摘した。同時に、ファンドによるレバレッジの利用と全体的な不透明性が金融システムにリスクをもたらす可能性があると警告した。

ＩＭＦは６日、世界金融安定報告書の一部の公表にあわせ、この調査結果を発表した。報告書全文は１０月１３日に公表される。調査結果は以下のとおり。

• ヘッジファンドは、トレーディング、流動性、リスク移転においてますます重要な役割を担っており、ファンドの資産は２０１３年のわずか４兆ドルから２６年初頭には約１３兆ドルにまで大幅に増加している。

• ヘッジファンドの成長は主にレバレッジ、特にデリバティブを通じた合成レバレッジによってもたらされてきた。

• こうしたファンドは、特に米国債市場において、その存在感を著しく高めている。ヘッジファンドは現在、米国債市場の９％を占めており、２２年のわずか４％から大幅に増加している。

• ヘッジファンドの存在感が高まることで市場効率が向上する可能性がある一方で、特にこれらの企業がレバレッジを利用し、リスクに対する制約が少ないことから、市場が悪化した際にストレスを増幅させる可能性もある。

• ヘッジファンドは依然として「本質的に不透明」であり、リスクやエクスポージャーを正確に評価することが困難である。政策立案者は、データ不足を解消し、潜在的な脆弱性に対する同セクターのリスク監視を強化する必要がある。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も コラム：米法律事務所、ロースクール1年生に採用攻勢　人材争奪戦が過熱 アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 アングル：米株高支える高い増益、投資家は持続可能性に不安も コラム：米だけ「異世界」のＩＭＦ会合　イラン戦争無視で政権の苦境露呈 最終更新: 10/6(火) 23:21 ロイター

item.title: IMF says hedge funds' market footprint growing, merits closer scrutiny
item.description: Hedge funds have more than tripled in size in the last decade and now play increasingly critical market roles, the International Monetary Fund said Tuesday, while warning that the funds' use of leverage and overall opacity can inject risks into the financial system.
item.dc:creator: Pete Schroeder
item.content:encoded: Hedge funds have more than tripled in size in the last decade and now play increasingly critical market roles, the International Monetary Fund said Tuesday, while warning that the funds' use of leverage and overall opacity can inject risks into the financial system. The findings were published Tuesday by the IMF as it released a chapter of its Global Financial Stability Report, which will be released in full on Oct. 13. Here's what the group found: Hedge funds are playing an increasingly prominent role in trading, liquidity and risk transfers, as assets at the funds now stand at roughly $13 trillion in early 2026, up significantly from just $4 trillion in 2013 Hedge fund growth has primarily come through leverage, including synthetic leverage through derivatives Such funds have grown their footprint significantly in sovereign bond markets, particularly US Treasuries. Hedge funds now account for 9% of the Treasury market, compared to just 4% in 2022 While greater hedge fund presence can boost market efficiency, the IMF warned they can also amplify stress when markets deteriorate, particularly due to those firms' use of leverage and fewer constraints on risk The IMF warned that hedge funds remain "inherently opaque," making it difficult to accurately gauge their risks and exposures. It called on policymakers to close data gaps and boost risk monitoring of the sector for potential vulnerabilities

item.title: アイスランドは北大西洋・北極圏防衛の要、安保協力継続が重要＝米国務長官
item.description: ［６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［６日　ロイター］ - ルビオ米国務長官は６日、訪問先のアイスランドで同国のグンナルスドッティル外相と共同記者会見を行い、アイスランドは北大西洋・北極圏防衛で中核的な役割を担っているとし、脅威が増大する中、安全保障分野で協力を継続することが重要だと述べた。

ルビオ長官は北極圏の軍事、経済、インフラ面での脅威への懸念に言及した上で、「アイスランドは米軍による戦力投射を可能にしてきた。アイスランドの陸・空・海の領域を活用しながら協力することで、秘密活動を監視し、敵対勢力を抑止するための重要な拠点を提供している」と述べた。

その上で「アイスランドの地理的位置は、欧州だけでなく米国本土の防衛にとっても極めて重要だ」とし、「さらに何ができるかを探るため協議を行う用意がある。双方が協力拡大に関心を持っていると認識している」と語った。

item.title: Marvell raises 2028 revenue forecast on strong AI data center demand
item.description: Marvell Technology raised its fiscal 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, above Wall Street estimates, as demand for its custom data center chips grows along with a surge in AI spending.
item.dc:creator: Prathik Jayaprakash, Anhata Rooprai, Max Cherney
item.content:encoded: Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) raised its fiscal 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, above Wall Street estimates, as demand for its custom data center chips grows along with a surge in AI spending. Shares of the Santa Clara, California-based company rose about 6%, while those of rival Broadcom (AVGO.O) advanced about 4%. "It took a long time to get this company on this path and to be a technology leader," Chris Koopmans, Marvell's president and chief operating officer, said in an interview. "We have a track record of doing what we said we're going to do." Marvell outlined a strategy in 2021 centered on custom and cloud-optimized silicon — chips specifically designed for use in data centers. It has been one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI infrastructure boom since then and projects it will generate $12 billion in custom chip revenue in fiscal 2029, up from a prior target of $10 billion. The company's custom chip business has become a major growth engine, with technology companies developing in-house AI processors to reduce reliance on Nvidia (NVDA.O) chips. Marvell's stock has more than tripled in value so far this year. Marvell disclosed a deal with Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) in August that could generate up to $120 billion in sales through fiscal 2033, if performance milestones are achieved. That same month, it raised its full-year revenue outlook to about $18 billion from $16.5 billion. On Tuesday, Marvell forecast fiscal 2031 revenue of $70 billion to $90 billion. At $80 billion, the midpoint of that range exceeds Wall Street estimates of $46.85 billion, according to four analysts polled by Visible Alpha. Analysts were expecting revenue of $18.2 billion for 2028, according to data compiled by LSEG.

item.title: US software stocks scale fresh 2026 highs as AI disruption worries fade
item.description: Oct 6 : US software stocks are touching fresh 2026 highs, supported by a sharp rise in earnings expectations, which according to several analysts indicate that fears over AI-led disruption in the sector were largely overstated.The S&P 500 software and services index rose 1.3 per cent on Tuesday to its highest

FAST

Oct 6 : US software stocks are touching fresh 2026 highs, supported by a sharp rise in earnings expectations, which according to several analysts indicate that fears over AI-led disruption in the sector were largely overstated. The S&P 500 software and services index rose 1.3 per cent on Tuesday to its highest levels since November 2025, after posting its biggest quarterly jump in July-September since the second quarter of 2020. Strong earnings from software companies such as Salesforce, ServiceNow and Accenture, along with partnerships with AI labs, helped fuel a recovery in the sector that had been underway since late June. Cybersecurity stocks have stood out, with Crowdstrike, Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks notching triple digit percentage gains this year as companies spend heavily on cybersecurity in the age of AI.

"AI has been more of an enabler for a lot of these software companies, more than a disruptor," said Adam Turnquist, chief cross-asset strategist at LPL Financial. "We're seeing more of a trend change now where software has recaptured the leadership reins, and we think there's a window here for outperformance in software over semiconductors." The software index is up 5 per cent this year while the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index, home to many US chipmakers, has surged 87.5 per cent in 2026, but is well off its highs. The sector's expected annual earnings growth rate for 2026 has climbed to 20.6 per cent, up from 13.8 per cent at the end of March, according to LSEG data. 'SAASPOCALYPSE' FEARS OVERDONE The software index lost more than 26 per cent from late January to its lowest point in April, in a selloff dubbed "SaaSpocalypse", driven by fears that companies could use AI to build applications in-house more cheaply. Analysts now say the fear ran ahead of evidence. "The whole SaaSpocalypse didn't happen anywhere near as fast as some of the people on Wall Street thought it would," said Rebecca Wettemann, CEO of technology research firm Valoir, adding that vendors were reporting customer uptake as AI adoption moved beyond the experimental stage. Still, risks to the sector persist as the fast-evolving technology upends business models. Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, said the real test for software stocks could come in the second half of 2027, when more data center capacity might make AI coding a bigger threat to traditional software firms.

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded:
Giuseppe Fonte　Kate Abnett　Alex Lawler

[ローマ／ロンドン　６日　ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）の理事会は、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）が先週発表したディーゼル燃料（軽油）および原油の備蓄放出に関する詳細を、１０月１４─１５日の会合で決定する見通しだ。この件に詳しい関係筋２人が６日、明らかにした。供給不足と過去最高水準の価格に対応するため、欧米がどれだけの量を放出するのかを巡り、市場で不透明感が広がっている。

Ｇ７は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、ＩＥＡを通じてディーゼル燃料などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。ただ、放出する原油、ディーゼル燃料、その他の製品の数量の内訳や、どの国が参加するのかは明らかにしていなかった。

関係筋の１人によると、Ｇ７加盟国であるイタリアが放出に加わる見通しだという。

ＩＥＡは、詳細が理事会で決定されるかどうかについてのコメント要請に対し、直ちには回答しなかった。

欧州委員会の報道官は６日、ＥＵの石油調整グループが７日に会合を開くと明らかにした。

ホワイトハウスは、備蓄放出の詳細を明らかにするよう求めたコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

石油市場関係者や一部のＥＵ加盟国の政府当局者も、Ｇ７の２日の発表の詳細について情報収集に追われている。商品取引大手ビトルのラッセル・ハーディ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６日、ロンドンで開かれた会議で、「具体的に何がどこで放出されるのか、十分に明確な発表ではなかった」とし、同社も備蓄放出の詳細をなお把握しようとしていると述べた。

Oct 6 : Citigroup estimates Meta's AI assistant Muse could generate more than $27 billion in revenue by 2030 as strong user adoption and growing engagement reinforce the platform's first-mover advantage in the emerging personal agent market. The brokerage said Muse is increasingly becoming the "front door to the internet," helping users search, compare and transact online, while Meta expands awareness and positions the product at the center of its broader AI strategy. • Citi said Muse's cumulative downloads have topped 6.6 million since its launch, while daily active users reached 1.8 million as new use cases emerge and Meta ramps up awareness efforts • The brokerage estimates Muse could account for more than $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030, including about $23 billion from transaction-related revenue and roughly $4.5 billion from subscriptions
