item.title: 米8月貿易赤字、1056億ドルと25年3月以来の高水準
item.description: [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 米商務省が６日発表した８月の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比１３．７％増の１０５６億...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米8月貿易赤字、1056億ドルと25年3月以来の高水準 10/6 22:42 配信

米カリフォルニア州ロングビーチ港沖に停泊するコンテナ船。７月撮影。REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni

[ワシントン　６日　ロイター] - 米商務省が６日発表した８月の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比１３．７％増の１０５６億ドルと、２０２５年３月以来の高水準となった。堅調な内需を背景に輸入が過去最高を記録し、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（１０２０億ドル）を上回った。第３・四半期も貿易が経済成長の押し下げ要因となる見通しとなった。

８月の輸入は４．３％増の４２０８億ドルと過去最高となった。モノの輸入は５．３％増の３４２２億ドル。石油を含む工業用資材・原材料が９１億ドル増加したことが押し上げ要因となった。

原油の輸入は３３億ドル増、非貨幣用金は３１億ドル増加した。資本財の輸入は、半導体やその他の産業機械がけん引し、６２億ドル増の１４６４億ドルと過去最高となった。一方、コンピューター周辺機器は１６億ドル減少した。

サービス輸入は１億ドル弱の増加にとどまり、７８５億ドルとなった。輸送サービスが小幅に増加した一方、知的財産使用料や旅行サービスは減少した。

８月の輸出は１．４％増の３１５２億ドル、モノの輸出は２．２％増の２０５７億ドルとなった。工業用資材・原材料が６３億ドル増加した。資本財の輸出は、半導体とコンピューターに押し上げられ１３億ドル増加。一方、民間航空機は１０億ドル減少した。 消費財の輸出は２２億ドル減少。医薬品が２４億ドル減少したことが響いた。

サービス輸出は１０９５億ドルと、１億ドル弱の増加にとどまった。知的財産使用料とその他ビジネスサービスが小幅に増加した一方、旅行サービスと金融サービスはともに減少した。

貿易は３四半期連続で国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の押し下げ要因となっており、エコノミストらは第３・四半期のＧＤＰを最大２．５％ポイント押し下げる可能性があると試算している。

第３・四半期の成長率予想は概ね年率３．０％を上回っており、個人消費が輸入によるマイナス影響を相殺すると見込まれている。第２・四半期の成長率は２．２％だった。

トランプ大統領は貿易赤字の縮小に向けて輸入品に対する強硬な関税措置を講じてきたものの、赤字は逆に拡大し、メキシコ、ベトナム、マレーシアに対するモノの貿易赤字は過去最大となった。台湾、中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）、韓国、カナダ、インドなどに対しても引き続き赤字となった。一方、ベルギーに対するモノの貿易黒字は過去最大を記録。オランダ、中南米、英国、香港、ブラジル、オーストラリア、サウジアラビアに対しても黒字を維持した。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「現政権の通商政策は概ね失敗に終わっており、関税措置は米国が外国製品への依存を低減することに何ら寄与していない」と指摘。「米国の労働コストは高過ぎるため、消費者が購入を検討できるほど安価な商品を国内で生産することはできない。たとえ米国の製造業者にその意思があったとしても、消費者が依存している商品を生産するための工場を国内に素早く建設することはできないだろう」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 最終更新: 10/7(水) 0:35 ロイター

Alien 'phoenix planet' was born from the ashes of a dying star

An artist’s impression of a second-generation planet orbiting the white dwarf HS 0209+0832, the first such planet to be found orbiting a white dwarf, in this image released on October 5, 2026. Snehalata Sahu/University of Warwick/Handout via REUTERS

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 6 : In ancient mythology, the phoenix was a miraculous bird with a cyclical pattern of life and death, perishing in flames only to rise again from the ashes. Astronomers have now found a world that rightly can be called a phoenix planet. Researchers said this exoplanet, as planets beyond our solar system are called, appears to have been born from material expelled into space during the death throes of a star a bit bigger than the sun, and now orbits the highly compact stellar remnant that was left behind, called a white dwarf. It is classified as a second-generation planet, meaning it did not form from the swirling disk of material surrounding a newborn star, as Earth and other first-generation planets did, but rather from the leftovers of a doomed star. "This is the first example of a planet forming around a white dwarf," said Jamie Williams, a doctoral student in astrophysics at the University of Warwick in England and lead author of the study published this week in the journal Nature Astronomy.

Show More

Show Less

The white dwarf is located about 250 light-years from Earth, near the constellation Cetus. A light-year is the distance light travels in a year, 5.9 trillion miles (9.5 trillion km). The planet is a gas giant perhaps slightly more massive than Jupiter, our solar system's largest planet. It orbits the white dwarf every 4.4 days at only 4 per cent the distance between Earth and the sun. It is so close that the blazingly hot white dwarf's extreme ultraviolet radiation is causing the planet's outer atmosphere to evaporate, with a portion then falling into the white dwarf. The planet's chemical pattern points to its second-generation origin. It is rich in niobium, copper and zinc, the type of elements that certain dying stars cast off when they expand in their death throes, indicating the planet formed from a disk of this expelled material that surrounded the stellar corpse. "In myths, a phoenix is born again from its own ashes. In the case of this planet, it is born again from the ashes of its dying host star, and therefore the planetary system is reborn. A second-generation planet is defined as one born after its host star dies — in this case after it has become a white dwarf," Williams said. The researchers used data from the orbiting Hubble, TESS and FUSE telescopes, and hope to use the James Webb Space Telescope to confirm their conclusions. A small number of potential second-generation planets previously have been identified orbiting pulsars, a rare type of neutron star, another type of stellar remnant. "White dwarfs are much more common than pulsars, and over 95 per cent of stars in the Milky Way will evolve to become a white dwarf. Therefore, there would be many more second-generation planets around white dwarfs than around pulsars," Williams said. While the newly discovered planet would be inhospitable for life, another second-generation planet potentially could be habitable. "If a gas giant formed around a white dwarf, then a rocky planet could form, too. White dwarfs cool predictably over time and as they get cooler, their cooling slows. So if a second-generation rocky planet formed close enough to the white dwarf then it could remain in the habitable zone for billions of years," Williams said. A RED DWARF AND A BROWN DWARF A second study published in the same journal describes another exotic celestial phenomenon roughly 300 to 500 light-years from Earth in the constellation Taurus. Researchers used the Zwicky Transient Facility at Palomar Observatory in California to discover a red dwarf star about 8 per cent of the mass of the sun in a tight orbit with a brown dwarf, an object too small to be a star and too big to be a planet. The brown dwarf is about 30 times the mass of Jupiter and a third of the mass of the star. These two companions orbit each other every 87 minutes at slightly more than half the distance between Earth and the moon, and the star's gravitational pull appears to be siphoning material from the brown dwarf. The researchers detected a hot spot on the star's surface where this material appears to be landing. "This is the first observed example of this phenomenon," said Aaron Householder, a Massachusetts Institute of Technology graduate student in astrophysics and lead author of the study. "The two objects are so close together that the entire orbit would fit inside the sun," Householder said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 生活費危機、インフレ期待や貧困に長期的な影響与える＝ＩＭＦ
item.description:
Andrea Shalal
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は６日に公表した研究報告書で、食...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
生活費危機、インフレ期待や貧困に長期的な影響与える＝ＩＭＦ 10/6 22:27 配信

国際通貨基金（IMF）のロゴ。2024年11月撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は６日に公表した研究報告書で、食料とエネルギー価格の急上昇は今後より頻繁に起こる可能性が高いと述べ、こうした危機はインフレ期待を長期にわたって高め、貧困を悪化させ、経済の安定を脅かすと警告した。

各国政府が物価高騰を緩和するために用いてきた３０年間の戦略を検証するとともに、生活必需品に家計のより大きな割合を費やす貧困層が経験する高いインフレ率を考慮した新たな経済モデルを提示。新しいモデルでは、標準的なインフレ指標との間に０．８％ポイントの乖離が見られ、２０２１年から２４年にかけて、以前の試算よりも２３００万人多い人々が極度の貧困ラインを下回ったことが示唆された。

研究を共同で主導したＩＭＦのエコノミスト、キアラ・マッジ氏は「要するに、生活費危機は物価安定に影響を与え、生活水準を低下させ、格差を悪化させる」と述べた。今回の研究は来週に公表される「世界経済見通し」の一部となる。

ジョージタウン大学教授で元世界銀行エコノミストのシャンタヤナン・デバラジャン氏は６日に公開されたマッジ氏とのビデオ対談の中で、原油価格の高騰、高水準の債務、借入コストの上昇、そして今年のスーパーエルニーニョ現象による影響が複合的に作用し、発展途上国は深刻な危機に直面していると指摘。「これは低所得国全体の成長率が過去最低水準にある時期に起こっている」とし、「成長率は著しく鈍化している」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：食品値下げは広がるのか、日銀判断にも影響する分岐点に アングル：イラン戦争による肥料高騰、穀物生産減少で食料危機の恐れも コラム：米だけ「異世界」のＩＭＦ会合　イラン戦争無視で政権の苦境露呈 アングル：トランプ減税、ガソリン代高騰で効果台無し アングル：イラン紛争で湾岸諸国の食料安全保障に打撃、輸入依存度は80％以上 最終更新: 10/6(火) 22:27 ロイター

item.title: US Senator Murphy says Pentagon denied him access to US base in Qatar
item.description: Democratic US Senator Chris Murphy said on Tuesday that the Department of Defense denied him access to a key military base in Qatar during a visit to the Middle East, describing it as part of a US government effort to conceal the impact of the Iran war.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari
item.content:encoded: Democratic US Senator Chris Murphy said on Tuesday that the Department of Defense denied him access to a key military base in Qatar during a visit to the Middle East , describing it as part of a US government effort to conceal the impact of the Iran war . The Al Udeid Air Base is the largest US base in the region and has repeatedly been attacked by Iran during the war launched by the US and Israel in February. "This trip confirmed for me that there is an active, unprecedented, unconstitutional effort underway to hide the costs of this war and the implications of this war from Congress and the American people," Murphy told a group of journalists in Riyadh, the second stop on his trip. Many members of Congress, including some of President Donald Trump's Republicans, have been pushing his administration to provide them with more information about the cost of the war, strategy and casualties. Asked for comment, a senior Pentagon official said Murphy's office had been informed before his trip that he would not receive the department's support to access the base, consistent with Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth's March 3, 2026, directive restricting travel to the area. "The Department applies the Secretary's guidance evenly," the official said in an emailed statement. Murphy said that the Pentagon refused to set up a briefing for him on the war while he was in the region. "I've never encountered anything like this in my time in the Senate and it's part of a deliberate campaign of obfuscation that my Republican colleagues in Congress should demand an end to," he said. He said that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio had facilitated his visit, including arranging meetings with diplomats, a stance he contrasted with that of the Pentagon. During his trip, Murphy, a member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee who represents the state of Connecticut, met with Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al Thani and with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman as well as other senior Gulf officials.

item.title: El euro repunta porque remite el temor por la deuda de Francia
item.description: El euro subió el martes, en camino a su mayor alza en siete semanas, tras haber caído en la sesión previa a su nivel más bajo en 17 meses, ya que el descenso del rendimiento de los bonos gubernamentales franceses atenuó el temor en los mercados de deuda de la zona euro.
item.dc:creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
item.content:encoded: El euro subió el martes, en camino a su mayor alza en siete semanas, tras haber caído en la sesión previa a su nivel más bajo en 17 meses, ya que el descenso del rendimiento de los bonos gubernamentales franceses atenuó el temor en los mercados de deuda de la zona euro. * La moneda única ganó un 0,35% , a 1,126 dólares, para su mayor subida diaria desde el 19 de agosto. El lunes tocó su mínimo desde mayo de 2025, a 1,116 dólares, tras un declive superior al 1% la semana pasada, su cuarto descenso semanal consecutivo. * El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde con una cesta de seis destacadas monedas, bajó un 0,32%, a 101,83 unidades, en su mayor caída diaria desde el 3 de septiembre. * Los rendimientos de los bonos han subido en los mercados mundiales por las expectativas de fuertes alzas de las tasas de interés, tras el repunte de los precios de la energía a raíz de la guerra en Irán, así como la preocupación sobre las finanzas públicas. * La deuda francesa se ha visto sometida a una presión cada vez mayor, mientras los políticos luchan por limitar el déficit presupuestario de cara a las divisivas elecciones de 2027. La convocatoria de elecciones anticipadas en España se sumaba a la presión reciente sobre el euro. * Los precios del crudo bajaron temprano, ya que el aumento de las exportaciones de crudo de Oriente Medio y la liberación de reservas de emergencia del G7 aliviaron las preocupaciones sobre el suministro. * Asimismo, las fuerzas gubernamentales yemeníes respaldadas por Arabia Saudita llevaron a cabo el lunes un avance relámpago para recuperar la costa alrededor del estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb hasta la ciudad de Mocha, según informó el Gobierno. * La libra esterlina subió un 0,42%, a 1,3275 dólares. Frente al yen, la moneda estadounidense avanzó un 0,11%, a 158,08 unidades.

item.title: New Maryland defense shipyard gets $6.6 billion commitment and Trump visit
item.description: Defense tech firm Anduril unveiled plans on Tuesday for a $3.7 billion shipyard in Maryland, and President Donald Trump was due to join an announcement ceremony for the project expected to generate 3,100 jobs and receive a $2.9 billion US Navy contract.
item.dc:creator: Nathan Gomes, Shivansh Tiwary, Trevor Hunnicutt
item.content:encoded: Defense tech firm Anduril unveiled plans on Tuesday for a $3.7 billion shipyard in Maryland, and President Donald Trump was due to join an announcement ceremony for the project expected to generate 3,100 jobs and receive a $2.9 billion US Navy contract. Anduril said the new high-tech shipyard at Sparrows Point, Maryland, near the Port of Baltimore would make components for the Navy's Virginia-class submarines. The Navy on Tuesday awarded Anduril a $2.9 billion contract to manufacture submarine components including torpedo tubes and doors. The investment and associated contract, together valued at up to $6.6 billion, come amid a broader push by the United States and its allies to expand arms production following Russia's invasion of Ukraine and conflicts in the Middle East. The project puts Trump in rare alignment with a frequent critic, Maryland Governor Wes Moore, a Democrat who is seen as a potential 2028 presidential candidate. Ahead of November's congressional elections, Trump is working to show that his policies have bolstered jobs and manufacturing while [USN:L6N45R10Y TEXT:"polls have shown"] that Trump's Republicans have lost voter support, largely over cost-of-living concerns. The president has argued that his tariffs and industrial policy will revive US factory work, from steelmaking to shipbuilding. Anduril's location in Maryland was formerly home to a large steel mill that went through decades of financial decline and closed in bankruptcy in 2012. Trump is touring the country in a pre-election blitz, announcing or claiming credit for a range of private-sector investments and government spending initiatives he has called "goodies." The new plant, dubbed Arsenal-2, is expected to be operational by the end of the decade, creating 3,100 direct jobs and supporting over 11,000 indirect jobs. Anduril is building another facility in California to manufacture Virginia-class submarine components and plans to expand into producing larger submarine modules and hull sections once its Baltimore shipyard becomes operational. Virginia-class submarines, which can travel at over 25 knots, are the Navy's latest generation of nuclear-powered attack submarines, designed for anti-submarine warfare, land-attack strikes and surveillance missions. General Dynamics' (GD.N) Electric Boat and Huntington Ingalls Industries (HII.N) jointly build the submarines. Anduril, founded in 2017 by Palmer Luckey, is a defense firm that is best known for its autonomous systems, drones and software built for the US military and its allies. Anduril's $1 billion [USN:L1N4070RY TEXT:"Arsenal-1 facility"] in Ohio began producing autonomous combat drones this year.

FAST

PARIS, Oct 6 : French AI startup Mistral unveiled a new AI model on Tuesday, ending a gap of about five months between major releases, and said it outperforms many rival open-weight models. The three-year-old company, widely viewed as Europe's strongest AI challenger to US and Chinese competitors, has not released a new model since May. In August, it began offering third-party models to customers, starting with Beijing-based Z.ai's GLM 5.3. "The model we're actually announcing today is actually above the Chinese models on certain aspects, including cyber. So the narrative that Europe cannot compete is something that is not true," CEO Artur Mensch said at a launch event in Abu Dhabi, without specifying which Chinese models or benchmarks he was referring to. Mistral said Le Chonk, officially named Mistral Large 4, will be made publicly available on October 27.

Before the release, cybersecurity experts and government authorities will be given access to a version with fewer safety restrictions to test its capabilities, the company said. Pierre Stock, Mistral's vice president of science, told Reuters that the model ranks among the strongest open-weight, systems available. Open-weight means users can download the model from platforms and run it on their own hardware. Many Chinese models are open-weight, while top US models tend to be closed and accessible only through their developers' infrastructure. SAFETY RISKS CONTAINED Stock told Reuters the model had tried to go beyond its testing environment, but that this was expected and the company was able to prevent it. OpenAI and Anthropic, whose most advanced models have demonstrated similar behaviour in testing, have restricted access to their most cyber-capable systems. After executives at US AI companies warned last month that AI could pose an existential threat to humanity, Mensch dismissed such arguments as self-serving. Mistral, which raised €3 billion ($3.4 billion) in its latest funding round, has positioned itself as a safer, European alternative. 'CLOSING THE GAP' Mistral said Large 4 is "closing the gap with frontier models" in areas including coding, finance, geospatial analysis, manufacturing and product design. The company trained the model on its own infrastructure. Stock said Mistral's goal was to partner "very deeply" with backers including ASML and new-investor Samsung "across the entire value chain". He said Large 4 is capable of designing computer chips, but declined to comment on whether Mistral is currently working with Samsung on chip development. ($1 = 0.8883 euros)

Source: Reuters

item.title: Sweden to deploy Patriot missiles to NATO hub in Poland
item.description: Sweden's Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson said on Tuesday the Nordic country will deploy Patriot missile defence systems to eastern Poland to help protect the NATO logistics hub that supplies weapons to Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sweden's Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson said on Tuesday the Nordic country will deploy Patriot missile defence systems to eastern Poland to help protect the NATO logistics hub that supplies weapons to Ukraine. Sweden will replace Patriot support from the Netherlands and the operation will start in December. It will deploy around 100 military personnel from the air defence unit in Halmstad, the government said Sweden [USN:L6N45M0TU TEXT:"last week announced"] that it was deploying Gripen fighter jets to Poland as part of a NATO airspace surveillance mission "The task of both the Gripen deployment and the Patriot deployment is...to protect NATO's logistics hub in Poland at the airport," Kristersson said Sweden declined to say how many Patriot system units would be sent to Poland Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk [USN:L8N4590UT TEXT:"said last month"], citing unnamed intelligence agencies, that Russia plans to launch 'hybrid' drone and missile attacks against countries supporting Ukraine Russia's President Vladimir Putin said last week that Russia had "no intention of attacking anyone...but if we are subjected to aggression, we will have no choice but to respond" (This story has been refiled to replace an incorrect image.)

item.title: 北朝鮮、地雷爆発巡る韓国正式見解に反発 「重大な挑発」
item.description:
Kyu-seok Shim
［ソウル ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kyu-seok Shim

［ソウル　６日　ロイター］ - 北朝鮮外務省は６日、南北境界地域の非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で韓国軍兵士２人が重傷を負った地雷爆発を巡る韓国の非難を一蹴し、領土を侵犯すれば「即時かつ強力な対抗措置」を取ると警告した。国営朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が伝えた。

韓国軍は５日、ＤＭＺでの爆発は、北朝鮮が仕掛けた地雷によるものだと結論付ける調査結果を発表した。

北朝鮮外務省は、韓国軍の発表は、爆発を北朝鮮と結び付けて北朝鮮への外交・軍事的措置を正当化するための「計画的な茶番劇」だと指摘。調査結果は「重大な挑発」で北朝鮮の主権を侵害するものだと非難した。

「韓国の軍靴や火花がほんの１ミリでも国境を越えてわが領土を侵犯すれば、北朝鮮の国境警備部隊は即時かつ強力な対抗措置を取る」とした。

さらに、韓国が進める地雷除去作業には関知しないとし、韓国側で同様の事案が再び起きた場合、責任は全て韓国にあると警告した。

韓国国防省の報道官は６日、地雷爆発を巡り、北朝鮮に謝罪を迫る対応策を準備していると明らかにした。金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記の妹である金与正党総務部長は２日、韓国側の謝罪要求を退けている。

item.title: Paramount wraps up mega Warner Bros merger to create Hollywood powerhouse Skydance
item.description: Paramount Skydance on Tuesday completed its blockbuster $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery , creating a Hollywood heavyweight that hands CEO David Ellison control of one of the world's largest entertainment and news businesses.
item.dc:creator: Anzar Mehraj, Harshita Varghese
item.content:encoded: Paramount Skydance on Tuesday completed its blockbuster $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery (WBD.O) , creating a Hollywood heavyweight that hands CEO David Ellison control of one of the world's largest entertainment and news businesses. The deal brings together the studios behind "Mission: Impossible," "Harry Potter" and DC Studios alongside major television and streaming networks such as CBS, CNN, Paramount+ and HBO Max — forming an expansive entertainment company spanning film, TV and news. Ellison laid out his vision for the new company in a memo to employees on Tuesday in which he said the acquisition is "to build the next-generation media and entertainment company, powered by creativity and technology." The goal, he added, was not simply to get bigger but "to take on the biggest players in our industry." The new company, called Skydance, is the latest iteration of a conglomerate once controlled by the late Sumner Redstone that has precipitously shrunk over the years, as audiences flock to news and entertainment delivered by a growing cadre of smaller publishers and creators chipping away at once-mighty Hollywood. Skydance not only faces competition from Netflix, Disney and others, but also from tech giants Apple, Meta, and Amazon, as well as the growing threat of AI. Shares of the combined company moved to the New York Stock Exchange from Nasdaq on Tuesday to trade under the ticker "SKYD." [USN:L4N45D11C TEXT:"Settlements"] with a [USN:L4N45D112 TEXT:"coalition of US states"] and a Hollywood writers union removed the main legal barriers to the merger, one of the largest in media history. It comes as Hollywood faces declining cable-TV subscriptions, the high cost of competing for streaming audiences and persistent pressure from unions over jobs and creative workers' rights. TRUMP'S CNN PROBLEM President Donald Trump expressed approval when asked about the deal. "It's going to be a great company," he told reporters . "That's a great merger. I'm glad they let it go." Trump has attacked news organizations since his first term and recently took the unprecedented step of [USN:L8N45A1OV TEXT:"banning several news outlets"] from the White House, including CNN. The move came weeks ahead of the November 3 midterm elections in which Trump's fellow Republicans are defending narrow majorities in Congress. CNN chief Mark Thompson and CBS News Editor-in-Chief Bari Weiss [USN:L4N45R0RX TEXT:"will continue"] in their respective leadership roles in the new company and each will separately report to Ellison and Kreiz, allaying [USN:L1N42I0HA TEXT:"concerns from critics"] that Weiss, who took over as CBS News editor-in-chief in 2025, would have greater control over all of Skydance's news operations. The concerns are also fueled by [USN:L1N43G107 TEXT:"lawmakers' criticism of Ellison"] for tailoring news coverage at Paramount-owned CBS News to favor Trump. As part of the settlement, Ellison agreed to create an editorial independence board to oversee CNN and CBS. Experts warn that the board will be "[USN:L4N45E0EO TEXT:"toothless"]." Ellison [USN:L6N45R0UG TEXT:"said last week"] the Skydance name was chosen to retain the individual identities of Paramount and Warner Bros studios, rather than combining them under a new brand. Wall Street analysts, however, said the name reinforces the extent of Ellison's control, highlighting how some of Hollywood's most iconic brands now answer to him and how he has a platform to impose his strategy and culture. In just 16 years, Skydance has gone from an independent studio to the center of one of Hollywood's biggest power plays. Founded in 2010 by the son of Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, it built its reputation as a financial backer and producer of Paramount's blockbuster "Top Gun: Maverick." After [USN:L4N3TZ1NM TEXT:"merging with"] Paramount last year, Skydance set its sights on Warner Bros, entering a heated bidding contest with Netflix (NFLX.O) while drawing interest from other potential suitors, including Comcast (CMCSA.O) . Warner Bros shareholders received an additional $41.9 million in a "ticking fee," based on the number of days between September-end and the deal-closing, according to a regulatory filing. BROADER HOLLYWOOD BET Ellison named Mattel's former CEO Ynon Kreiz as Skydance co-CEO to run day-to-day operations and lead the integration, while Ellison oversees creative direction and overall strategy. In bringing on Kreiz, Ellison has signaled the [USN:L4N45N0LV TEXT:"need for a cost-cutter"]. The duo faces the task of combining two large companies while delivering $6 billion in planned savings, a big part of which Paramount said would come from "non-labor sources." That includes combining technology and cloud providers of the two companies, but the scale of the cuts is expected to affect jobs across Hollywood. Skydance plans to combine its streaming services, including HBO Max and Paramount+, into a single service and has [USN:L1N45D0VR TEXT:"pledged to release at least 30 films"] each in the first two years after closing, rising to 32 a year for the following three. The combined company is also expected to carry about $80 billion in debt, putting pressure on Ellison to grow streaming, preserve cash flow from cable networks and improve theatrical film performance. Analysts at MoffettNathanson forecast profit, or EBITDA, of $16 billion for 2028 and rising to $19 billion in 2030. The research firm also predicted about $67 billion in revenue in 2028, growing to roughly $70 billion in 2030. Ellison's annual base salary will be $5 million, with a target annual bonus of $5 million, according to the filing.

Oct 6 : German software company SAP said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy TechWolf, a Belgian company that analyses workforce data to map employees' skills and tasks, for an undisclosed sum. item.title: Euroleague shareholders reject NBA Europe offer, door open for future talks
item.description: Euroleague shareholder clubs rejected a collaboration offer from the NBA on Tuesday, according to sources familiar with the discussions, raising the prospect of a battle for the continent's biggest teams, players and commercial riches.
item.dc:creator: Elvira Pollina
item.content:encoded: Euroleague shareholder clubs rejected a collaboration offer from the NBA on Tuesday, according to sources familiar with the discussions, raising the prospect of a battle for the continent's biggest teams, players and commercial riches. The door on a deal has yet to be closed though. The Euroleague said in a statement that its 13 shareholder clubs had agreed to convert into franchises, a change that would turn their current licences into a more lasting stake in the league. The clubs did not, however, take a formal decision on expanding the competition from 20 to 24 teams. Regarding Euroleague's expansion plan, a person attending the meeting told Reuters the decision on allocating additional long-term licences would be taken within the next month. The source said the Euroleague was keen to move ahead with expansion and attention will now be on whether the NBA submits a fresh proposal before those calls are made. Up to eight additional long-term licences could be awarded. The remaining places would be filled through a combination of short-term licences, wildcards and sporting qualification through the BKT EuroCup. A senior sports executive told Reuters any collaboration between Euroleague and the NBA was unlikely before 2028 because of the difficulty of organising a new competition in time for the 2027-28 season. Representatives of the 13 permanent shareholder clubs met near Lake Como to discuss the expansion plan, with the prospect of an agreement with the NBA dominating discussions around the future of European basketball. The Euroleague did not mention the widely reported NBA offer in its statement, but told Reuters last Friday it remained open to collaboration. Although the clubs rejected the current proposal, talks with the NBA could continue. Reuters was not immediately able to confirm the details of the NBA's offer but media reports said it would have seen the NBA's continental expansion project merge with Euroleague. The NBA did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. NBA Europe's managing director, George Aivazoglou, is due to speak at a conference in London on Thursday. The rejection is a significant setback to attempts to unite Europe’s established elite basketball competition with the financial and commercial power of the NBA, which plans to launch a 16-team NBA Europe league in 2027. SURGE OF INTEREST The NBA has stepped up its push into Europe amid a surge of interest in the sport, with Euroleague reporting in May an 82% increase in TV viewership through the first 25 regular-season rounds of the 2025-26 campaign. The NBA has also enjoyed growing momentum on the continent. Streaming deals with providers like Amazon Prime have boosted audiences for the NBA in Europe, while regular-season games in Berlin and London this year highlighted the league's growing appeal. Viewership of January's clash between Orlando Magic and Memphis Grizzlies in London was up 90% compared to the last NBA game there in 2019. A report from JB Capital commissioned by the Euroleague values the competition at €1.41 billion ($1.59 billion), while the aggregate value of its licensed teams was put at approximately €1.8 billion. Those figures pale in comparison to the NBA. The NBA recently surpassed Major League Baseball to become the world's second-richest sports league, according to Sports Value, a marketing and valuation agency, with upwards of $14 billion in revenue during the 2025-26 season. The NBA and Euroleague have said throughout this year that they would like to work together on a new competition, but each has also made clear it is prepared to pursue its own plans if no agreement is reached. No deadline has been set for a deal, although the sides have indicated they want greater clarity by the end of the season. ($1 = 0.8883 euros)

FAST

The United States has discussed starting reciprocal visits to nuclear sites with China, and plans to continue pushing in meetings in the coming months, CNN reported on Tuesday (Oct 6), citing sources familiar with the matter.

The idea of reciprocal visits was initially raised by China in meetings with US officials this year and visits to US Department of Energy national laboratories and equivalent Chinese facilities were discussed, CNN said, citing a source.

The discussions between US and Chinese officials have mainly been on the sidelines of gatherings by the UN Security Council's five veto-wielding permanent members, CNN reported.

Reuters could not immediately verify the report. The White House and the Chinese embassy in Washington did not respond to requests for comment outside business hours.

US President Donald Trump called for trilateral arms control negotiations between the US, China and Russia when he met President Xi Jinping last month. However, the two leaders did not discuss the possibility of nuclear site visits during their talks, the CNN report said, citing a US official.

Beijing has said its nuclear arsenal is far smaller than those of Russia and the US, something it says makes its participation in such talks unnecessary.

Another meeting between Trump and Xi is widely considered likely this year, potentially at November's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China or during Group of 20 meetings in the US in December.

By the time the two leaders meet again, it is expected that further lower-level discussions on possible nuclear site visits will have taken place, CNN said.

Oct 6 : Tereina, a payments company in which SAP owns a stake, on Tuesday launched technology that lets businesses pay suppliers, employees and affiliates directly from their SAP software in traditional currencies or stablecoins. The launch introduces a payments layer inside business software that companies already use to track their money. Until now, SAP had stopped short of payments and let customers connect their own providers, Tereina CEO Cedric Bru said, while declining to disclose the size of SAP's stake in the company. • SAP customers can subscribe to the new SAP Pay services under existing contracts • Bru compares the offering to Apple Pay as a payment service native to the system it runs in

item.title: ロシアのペスト研究所職員死亡、接触者に感染確認されず＝衛生当局
item.description: [モスクワ／シェレホフ（ロシア） ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ／シェレホフ（ロシア）　６日　ロイター] - ロシアの衛生監視機関である消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁（ロスポトレブナゾール）は６日、２日に死亡したシベリアのペスト研究所職員と接触した人の間で、ペストの発症例は確認されていないと発表した。

ロシアでは、東シベリアのイルクーツク近郊にあるシベリア・極東ペスト対策研究所に勤めていた２８歳の女性研究員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡。この件を巡っては、トランプ米大統領を含む国際社会から懸念の声が上がっている。

ロスポトレブナゾールは声明で、同研究所の職員の間で過去１０日間に感染症の報告はなく、詳しい検査でも死亡した女性の体内から業務に関連する微生物は見つからなかったと発表。公衆衛生関連法に基づき包括的な防疫措置を直ちに実施し、患者と接触した可能性のある人を病院での医学観察下で検査を毎日実施した結果、接触者の中に感染症に関連する健康状態の変化がみられた者はいなかったと明らかにした。

イルクーツク近郊シェレホフ地区のソフィナ副地区長も、危険な感染症は確認されなかったと述べた。同地区では地元の病院が隔離措置の対象となっているが、隔離された人の約６０％はすでに解除されたという。

FAST

LONDON, Oct 6 : US start-up Type One Energy has raised $200 million from investors including the venture unit of Germany's Siemens Energy, as it vies to build the world's first commercial fusion reactor, its chief executive told Reuters. The Series-B round, which takes total funding to-date to more than $400 million, is the third-biggest sector Series B raise over the last five years, data from industry tracker PitchBook showed. The company did not disclose its valuation. Fusion energy has been researched for decades. A wave of firms has launched in recent years as advances in magnets, computing and materials have fuelled hopes fusion technology could one day provide abundant clean power across the globe. Type One is backed by Bill Gates' Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Clutterbuck Capital. It is developing a stellarator, a type of fusion reactor that uses complex magnetic fields to contain superheated plasma, partnering with engineering, construction and other companies to speed up delivery and reduce costs.

Chief Executive Christofer Mowry said the funds would help further develop its technology, including the deployment of an engineering prototype machine, Infinity One. "It's not an experimental science project... the only thing that we want to learn is that our design for the fusion machine in the power plant works as advertised." Project Infinity is based at Bull Run in Tennessee and Type One hopes to launch the commercial plant, Infinity Two, within a decade. It aims to work towards a manufacturing partnership with Siemens. Enrique Gonzalez Zanetich, partner at Siemens Energy Ventures, said in a statement that the deal strengthened his company's position in fusion "as we continue to explore the technologies and collaborations that can help advance commercialization". New investors alongside Siemens included Lowercarbon Capital, co-founded by early Uber backer Chris Sacca, and SiteGround Capital.

item.title: Becton Dickinson pledges $19 billion US investment in deal with government
item.description: Becton Dickinson became the first major US medical device company to strike a deal with the government to expand its domestic manufacturing, pledging $19 billion over several years in return for shelter from future tariffs.
item.dc:creator: Siddhi Mahatole
item.content:encoded: Becton Dickinson (BDX.N) became the first major US medical device company to strike a deal with the government to expand its domestic manufacturing, pledging $19 billion over several years in return for shelter from future tariffs. Under the agreement, the company on Tuesday said it plans to make capital, operational and supply chain investments in the US, with $3 billion earmarked for strategic manufacturing sites across the country. Shares of the medical device maker were up 2.4% in morning trading. The deal follows the Trump administration's [USN:L4N3TZ1L7 TEXT:"push"] to use tariff threats to spur domestic healthcare manufacturing, with [USN:L4N4470VR TEXT:"major drugmakers already pledging billions"] for new and expanded US production and research facilities. The agreement ties BD's US manufacturing commitments to relief from future tariffs on covered products and inputs under Section 232, subject to the final scope of the measures and the company meeting agreed milestones. "We think tariff clarity or the potential for levies to be 'less bad' than feared could be a clearing event for MedTech," said Jefferies analyst Mathew Taylor, adding "we wonder if there are more MedTech announcements in the works." The company plans to expand US production by about 5 billion essential medical consumables annually, raising the share it supplies domestically to roughly 80%. It also plans to manufacture all needles used in the US domestically using American-made steel. Becton Dickinson said it was not currently quantifying the financial impact of the agreement because the final tariff rates, product scope and timing have not yet been determined. The announcement builds on President Donald Trump's [USN:L1N45S036 TEXT:"statement on Monday"] that the company had agreed to invest $3 billion to bring manufacturing of essential medical products to the United States, with more than $1 billion going to Nebraska. In January, Becton announced a $110 million investment in Columbus, Nebraska, to expand prefillable syringe and cannula production, adding about 120 jobs, with syringe production expected to begin supplying customers in mid-2026.

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 6 : Google has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy in the largest US power grid, with new nuclear energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday. Constellation will make more than $4.3 billion of new investments in its fleet as part of the agreement, which involves adding capacity at several of the power company's nuclear reactors in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, the companies said. Major tech companies are racing to secure massive amounts of electricity supplies to power data centers across the US by striking unprecedented power deals and reviving the country's nuclear industry. Over the last two years, Constellation unveiled an agreement to restart its Three Mile Island reactor in Pennsylvania to serve Microsoft data centers, while Google contracted to restart NextEra Energy's nuclear power plant in Iowa.

In the latest arrangement, Google entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts of electricity from multiple Constellation-owned nuclear power plants, which would be upgraded to produce more electricity from existing reactors. Electricity from the first of the upgraded plants is expected to be delivered in 2028, the companies said. Google also entered into a 15-year supply agreement for an additional 2,700 megawatts of power from Constellation in the PJM power grid. That power is not tied to a specific generation source and serves as long-term revenue certainty for Constellation's operating plants, Google said. Shares of Constellation were up by more than 13 per cent on Tuesday to $304.04 by mid-morning. Maryland-based Constellation is the largest US nuclear power plant operator and owns a major fleet of natural-gas-fired power plants as well as geothermal energy following its acquisition of electricity producer Calpine Corp earlier this year. "We’re committed to meeting our growth responsibly by actively investing in clean, reliable power that brings new capacity to our nation's grids," said Amanda Peterson Corio, Google's global head of energy and power, in a statement.  The 11 nuclear units expected to be upgraded as part of the arrangement with Google are in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey, within the footprint of the largest US electric grid - PJM Interconnection.  Rising electricity demand driven largely by the data center expansion has contributed to a more than 11-fold increase in PJM capacity prices since 2024 and left the grid with a power shortfall. In response, PJM management has proposed requiring data center customers connected to the 13-state grid to either bring their own power or face being shut off from grid power remotely in times of peak demand. The deal between Google and Constellation is in response to PJM's "bring your own power" proposal. It also creates a "practical model for how major power consumers can expand new supply alongside growing operational requirements, without state or federal mandates," the companies said.  Google and Constellation also agreed on a strategic framework that can be replicated to develop power generation, battery storage, and a flexible power use model known as "demand response" in other parts of the US, the companies said. Joe Dominguez, chairman, president and CEO of Constellation, said the arrangement with Google is a "model for how technology companies and the energy industry can work together to responsibly develop the digital economy and invest in our nation’s energy infrastructure in a way that delivers grid-wide benefits for all, funded by private entities."

Source: Reuters

item.title: サウジ東西パイプライン、送油量580万バレル＝エネ相
item.description: [６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[６日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアのアブドルアジズエネルギー相は６日、紅海沿岸の石油輸出拠点ヤンブーに通じる東西パイプラインの送油量が、同日朝の時点で５８０万バレルに達したと明らかにした。

サウジとイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派との戦闘が続く中、同パイプラインで最近、送油が中断したとの報道があったが、関係筋は５日、ロイターに対し中断はしていないと述べた。

関係筋３人によると、サウジは東西パイプラインの操業を再開した。同パイプラインはイラクの民兵組織によるものとされる無人機（ドローン）攻撃を受け、９月１１日に送油を停止し、ヤンブーでの原油の積み込みも中断していた。

item.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq reach record closing highs as focus pivots to earnings
item.description: US stocks ended higher on Tuesday as crude prices steadied and US Treasury yields eased, offering some reprieve from concerns that have preoccupied investors in recent weeks, and allowing markets to turn their attention to the approaching third-quarter reporting season.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: US stocks ended higher on Tuesday as crude prices steadied and US Treasury yields eased, offering some reprieve from concerns that have preoccupied investors in recent weeks, and allowing markets to turn their attention to the approaching third-quarter reporting season. The broad rally pushed the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq to all-time closing highs. The blue-chip Dow remains just over 5% shy of its record closing level reached on August 5. When oil prices stabilize or move lower, "that causes yields to move down because there's less anxiety about energy-driven inflation, which in turn is helping lift stocks higher," said Oliver Pursche, senior vice president at Wealthspire Advisors in New York. "This has been the narrative of the market for the last couple of weeks." Six of the "Magnificent Seven" group of AI-linked megacap firms advanced, bolstering gains, while small-caps (.RUT) lagged their larger-cap counterparts. The AI trade is very much alive, with the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor Index (.SOX) gaining ground. Expenditures on AI-related infrastructure were reflected in international trade data, which showed imports of capital goods rose by 4.4% in August. The Commerce Department's report showed the [USN:L1N45S0IV TEXT:"US trade deficit"] grew by 13.7% as imports rose to a record high. On monthly and annual bases, imports have grown by 4.3% and 28.4%, respectively, reflecting robust domestic demand that could exacerbate inflation pressures, particularly amid war-related supply constraints. Even so, financial markets are currently pricing in a diminishing probability of 19.4% that the US Federal Reserve will implement its second consecutive rate hike at this month's monetary policy meeting, down from 50.9% a week ago, according to CME's FedWatch tool. Fed rate hike bets have been responsive to [USN:L1N45S05E TEXT:"oil prices"], which have surged amid the Iran war, threatening to morph into broader price pressures. But supply worries eased after the Group of Seven countries reached an agreement to release emergency diesel and crude stockpiles, helping to stabilize front-month WTI and Brent crude futures. "We don't expect (the Fed) to do anything at the next meeting," said Tim Ghriskey, senior portfolio strategist at Ingalls & Snyder in New York. "But I think they're in a gradual hiking cycle." "High oil prices have hit a broad range of consumers," Ghriskey added. "That's one of the reasons for the recent Fed hike." The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 253.14 points, or 0.49%, to 51,521.04, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 45.00 points, or 0.58%, to 7,818.95 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained 122.48 points, or 0.45%, to 27,599.79. Of the 11 major sectors in the S&P 500, all but healthcare (.SPXHC) gained ground, with utilities (.SPLCRU) leading the way. Third-quarter earnings season kicks off next week, with a number of high-profile financial firms expected to report next Tuesday. Analysts currently expect annual S&P 500 earnings growth of 30.6%, in aggregate, for the July-to-September period, led by an expected 114.7% jump in energy earnings, followed by a 66.5% estimated surge in tech results, according to LSEG. Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) climbed 5.8% following the [USN:L6N45S0Y5 TEXT:"chip designer's"] 2028 revenue forecast hike due to strong demand for its data center chips. Chipmaker AMD (AMD.O) gained 2.8% after CEO Lisa Su said [USN:L6N45S09C TEXT:"it plans"] to substantially increase its chip supply in 2027 to meet booming AI demand. Constellation Energy (CEG.O) jumped 12.3% after Alphabet (GOOGL.O) entered into a 3,590-megawatt power [USN:L6N45S04O TEXT:"deal"] with the company. Option Care Health (OPCH.O) soared 32.7% after drug distributor McKesson (MCK.N) and private equity firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice [USN:L4N45S0SZ TEXT:"agreed to buy"] the infusion therapy provider in a deal worth about $5.8 billion, including debt. Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.93-to-1 ratio on the New York Stock Exchange. There were 258 new highs and 219 new lows on the NYSE. On the Nasdaq, 2,394 stocks rose and 2,378 fell as advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.01-to-1 ratio. The S&P 500 posted 23 new 52-week highs and 2 new lows while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 61 new highs and 182 new lows. Volume on US exchanges was 16.50 billion shares, compared with the 17.51 billion average for the full session over the last 20 trading days.

item.title: 米中、核施設相互視察を協議 中国が提案とＣＮＮ報道
item.description: ［６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［６日　ロイター］ - 米ＣＮＮは６日、米国が中国との間で核施設相互視察の開始について協議しており、今後数カ月の間に予定されている対面会談でも、その実現に向けて引き続き働きかけていく方針だと報じた。

ＣＮＮが関係筋の話として伝えたところによると、相互訪問の構想は今年行われた米中当局者の協議で中国側が提起し、米エネルギー省傘下の国立研究所や中国の同等施設への訪問が検討された。米中当局者協議は主に、国連安全保障理事会常任理事国の会合の合間に行われてきたという。

トランプ米大統領は先月、中国の習近平国家主席と会談した際、米中ロ３カ国による軍備管理交渉を呼びかけた。中国はかねて、自国の核戦力はロシアや米国に比べてはるかに小さく、そうした協議への参加は不要だとの立場を示している。

ＣＮＮは、米政府当局者の話として、両首脳が会談で核施設訪問の可能性について協議しなかったと伝えた。その上で、両首脳が再会談するまでに、核施設訪問の可能性を巡る実務レベルの協議がさらに行われる見通しだとした。

トランプ氏と習近平国家主席の年内の再会談は公算が大きいと広く見られており、１１月に中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議、または１２月に米国で開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）会合の機会に行われる可能性がある。

item.title: TSX climbs to 11-day high as bond yields ease
item.description: Canada's main stock index rose to an 11-day high on Tuesday, led by utilities and metal mining shares, as the recent sell-off in the global bond market eased and after a deal which will create one of Canada's top power providers.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Fergal Smith
item.content:encoded: Canada's main stock index rose to an 11-day high on Tuesday, led by utilities and metal mining shares, as the recent sell-off in the global bond market eased and after a deal which will create one of Canada's top power providers. The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) ended up 130.96 points, or 0.4%, at 35,649.51, its highest closing level since September 25. [USN:L1N45S0RM TEXT:"US Treasuries rebounded"] after a sharp selloff in the previous session pushed long-term yields to multi-decade highs, as investors paused to assess recent moves ahead of next week's inflation data, which could offer fresh clues on the path of interest rates. "I'd be focused more on interest rates, the 10-year yield in the United States, than I would be on energy prices, although they're related," said Matt Skipp, president at SW8 Asset Management. "A moderating oil price seems to have the potential to lower yields, as investors worry less about inflation," Skipp added. Lower bond yields tend to increase the attractiveness of high-dividend paying utilities stocks, with the sector rising 1.3%. [USN:L4N45S0P5 TEXT:"Emera"] (EMA.TO) said it would buy peer Canadian Utilities (CU.TO) for C$14.3 billion ($10.02 billion) in stock, strengthening its financial muscle as power companies ramp up investments to tap into booming demand. ATCO (ACOx.TO) , which holds nearly 37% of the outstanding non-voting shares and all outstanding voting shares of Canadian Utilities, said it will separate into a publicly traded industrial services company. Emera shares fell 2.9%, Canadian Utilities was down nearly 2% and ATCO ended 9.2% higher. The materials sector (.GSPTTMT) , which includes metal mining shares, added 0.4% as the price of gold recovered from an earlier two-month low to increase 0.7%. US crude oil futures settled up 1 cent at $89.44 a barrel after earlier touching a five-week low at $86.86. Energy (.SPTTEN) fell 0.6%, while industrials (.GSPTTIN) were down 0.7% as railroad shares lost ground.

item.title: 日本の対米投資は中国依存度を低下、日中対話進展は期待＝米上院議員
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 来日中のデービッド・マコーミック米上院議員は６日、都内で記者団の取材に応じ、日米両国が合意した５５００億ドル（約８７兆円）の対米投融資について、米国の製造業再生や日本の米市場へのアクセス獲得に加え、サプライチェーン（供給網）を中国から切り替えることで日米両国の対中依存度を低下させる効果があると述べた。

一方、マコーミック氏は中国が経済、軍事的に世界のリーダーの座を争う「敵対国」だとする一方、「共通点を探る努力は必要だ」と指摘。日本について「（世界有数の経済大国で）非常に重要な国だ。そして中国と同じ地域にあり、両国が対話を続けるのは理にかなったことだ」と話した。トランプ大統領と習近平国家主席の最近の会談に触れ、トランプ氏と高市早苗首相は「極めて緊密な関係にある」として米国の後押しで日中対話が進むことに期待を示した。

マコーミック氏は、日本製鉄が買収した米鉄鋼大手ＵＳスチールの本社があるペンシルベニア州選出。「ペンシルベニアにとっても米国にとっても、日本にとっても素晴らしい案件だと確信し、ホワイトハウスに行き、大統領執務室で大統領と会ってこの案件を支持するよう働きかけた」と振り返った。

item.title: ノーベル平和賞委、新たな協力を推進する人々に注目＝事務局長
item.description:
Nora Buli Gwladys Fouche
[オスロ ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nora Buli　Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ ６日 ロイター] - ノルウェー・ノーベル委員会(ノーベル平和賞委員会)のクリスティアン・ベルグ・ハルプビケン事務局長は、激動の中にある世界秩序の再編と、同賞の目的に沿った新たな協力の在り方を推進する人々を注視していると述べた。

同委員会は５人のメンバーで構成される。事務局長は候補に関する資料をまとめ、審議に参加するが、投票権はない。今年の受賞者発表は９日に行われる。

ハルプビケン氏は５日のインタビューで、世界が激動しているからといって、候補が不足しているわけでも、平和賞がその意義を失っているわけでもないと指摘。「賞そのものについては心配していないが、世界がどこへ向かっているのかについては懸念している」と付け加えた。

item.title: 「ニュートリノマン」にノーベル物理学賞、南極での国際研究事業主導
item.description: ［ストックホルム ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ストックホルム　６日　ロイター］ - スウェーデン王立科学アカデミーは６日、２０２６年のノーベル物理学賞を、ベルギー出身の素粒子物理学者フランシス・ハルツェン氏（米ウィスコンシン大学マディソン校教授）に授与すると発表した。授賞理由は「アイスキューブ・ニュートリノ観測所への決定的な貢献と、天体起源の高エネルギーニュートリノの発見」。

ハルツェン氏は、南極に設置した観測施設「アイスキューブ」での国際研究プロジェクトを主導した。

王立科学アカデミーのエバ・オルソン氏は記者会見で「（ニュートリノという）メッセンジャーは宇宙から情報を運んでくる」と述べ、「遠くの銀河への扉を開き、星が爆発する過程を教えてくれる」と語った。

ノーベル物理学委員会のマーク・ピアース委員長は声明で「ハルツェン氏は国際的な研究者・技術者チームを率い、素晴らしい観測装置をもたらしてくれた」とし、「その粘り強さと科学的な先見性が、新しい種類の天文学への道を開いた」とも語った。

ハルツェン氏は電話で記者会見に参加し、「自分がいかに幸運だったかを強調したい。このプロジェクトを始めた時、良いアイデアかもしれないとは誰もが思っていたが、うまくいくと考えた人はほとんどいなかった。私自身もそうだった」と語った。

ベルギーのデウェーフェル首相は、「宇宙の最も小さな現れを通じて、宇宙の最大の謎の解明にささげた人生」が認められたと称えた。

ニュートリノは地球や人体を跡形もなく通り抜け、物質とはごくまれにしか反応しないため、「幽霊粒子」と呼ばれることもある。ハルツェン氏は、南極点の氷を使えばニュートリノを追跡できることに気付いた。１９８８年、南極点でニュートリノの痕跡を捉えるという構想を初めて発表したが、プロジェクトの完成は２０１１年までかかった。

アイスキューブは、アムンゼン・スコット南極点基地の近くの地下深くにあり、５０００個を超えるセンサーが設置されている。

高エネルギーニュートリノは質量がほぼゼロで、他の粒子と違ってエネルギーを失ったり方向を変えたりしない。アイスキューブはその信号を待ち受け、経路をさかのぼって発生源を突き止めることを目指している。

ハルツェン氏は６日の会見で、自身の研究で宇宙について具体的に何が分かるかを語るのは尚早とし、「本当にわくわくするのは、その質問にまだ答えられないことだ。これは科学の入り口にすぎず、天文学としての成果はこれからだ」と語った。

米スミソニアン誌は１４年にハルツェン氏に「独創性賞」を贈った。その際、同氏を「ニュートリノマン」と呼び、「天文学の新時代の幕開けを告げる驚くべき実験」と称え、ハルツェン氏の半生を描いた漫画「一人の物理学者の宇宙探求はいかにして南極で飛躍したか（How OnePhysicist’s Pursuit of the Cosmos Took Off in Antarctica）」を掲載した。

item.title: 米国民、税金使う選挙広告に不信感＝ロイター／イプソス世論調査
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt Jason Lange
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jason Lange

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスが実施した世論調査によると、１１月の中間選挙を前にトランプ大統領が出演するテレビＣＭが放映される中、圧倒的多数の米国民が選挙の頃に大統領を起用したテレビＣＭに税金を使うのは不適切だと回答した。

５日に終了した６日間の世論調査によると、米国民の８６％、そして共和党員の５人に４人が、大統領や閣僚を起用した選挙関連のテレビ広告に税金を使うのは不適切だと考えていることが分かった。

倫理専門家や両党の議員は、中間選挙の数週間前に放映された「アメリカの黄金時代」を称える３つの全国放送広告を批判。議員らは公金がトランプ氏の政治的宣伝に使われているのではないかと疑問を呈しており、他の批判者らはこれらの広告が政府の宣伝活動や政治活動に関する規制に違反する可能性があると指摘している。

トランプ氏と側近らは、これらの広告は教育的かつ愛国的なものであり、特定の政治家候補を後押しする意図はないと述べている。

トランプ氏は５日夜、広告費は自ら支払うか、政治活動委員会（ＰＡＣ）の「ＭＡＧＡ」が集めた資金で賄うと表明した。

各広告の最後には、米国政府が費用を負担した旨が記載されている。

民主党議員らは独立した調査を求め、ホワイトハウスが広告放映のために国土安全保障省の資金２０００万ドルを流用したと主張している。

また、世論調査によると、回答者の約７１％が米首都ワシントンの総合文化施設ケネディ・センターの名称をトランプ氏の名前を含むものに変更することに反対している。共和党員でこの案を支持しているのはわずか４分の１だった。

さらに、共和党支持者の間では、一部の記者をホワイトハウスから締め出すことに賛成する人が多く、５７％が賛成。一方、民主党支持者と無党派層は圧倒的に反対した。全体として、回答者の６８％がこうしたやり方は不適切だと答えた。

調査はオンラインで全米規模で実施され、米国の成人４５０６人から回答を得た。

item.title: Americans deeply skeptical of taxpayer-funded election ads, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
item.description: An overwhelming majority of Americans said that it is inappropriate to use taxpayer funds for TV ads featuring the president around an election, in a Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted as spots with President Donald Trump air ahead of November's midterms.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt, Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: An overwhelming majority of Americans said that it is inappropriate to use taxpayer funds for TV ads featuring the president around an election, in a Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted as spots with President Donald Trump air ahead of November's midterms. The six-day poll, which concluded on Monday, found that 86% of Americans — and four out of five Republicans — think it is inappropriate to use taxpayer money to pay for election-related TV ads featuring the president or his cabinet. Ethics experts and lawmakers from both parties have criticized three nationally broadcast ads that celebrate a "golden age of America" airing weeks before the November 3 midterm elections . Lawmakers have questioned whether public funds are being used to promote Trump politically, while other critics say the spots may violate longstanding restrictions on government propaganda and political activity. Trump and his aides have said the ads are educational, patriotic and not intended to promote any politician's candidacy. "These public service announcements are about reminding Americans to love their country and understand what makes it worth defending, at home, at our borders, and abroad," said a White House spokesperson who declined to be named. Trump said late on Monday that he would pay for ads himself or with money raised from the MAGA political committee. A White House official said on Tuesday that Trump was referring to the MAGA Inc PAC paying for future ads but did not plan to reimburse taxpayers for the ads that the government has paid for in recent weeks. One ad features Trump declaring that "America will never be a communist country" while a chorus repeats "love me." Another combines images of Mount Rushmore with footage of Trump praising a "golden age of America." A third describes a "final battle" against the "deep state" and closely resembles one of Trump's 2024 campaign advertisements. Each ad ends with a disclaimer that it was paid for by the US government. Democratic lawmakers have sought independent investigations and said that the White House [USN:L1N45N046 TEXT:"transferred $20 million"] in Homeland Security Department funds to air the ads. PRESSURE ON REPUBLICANS AHEAD OF ELECTIONS Republicans seeking reelection face growing pressure as the president's approval rating sits at [USN:L6N45R10Y TEXT:"record lows"]. Trump has taken a series of unusual steps in recent months promoting his brand and accomplishments, including a [USN:L6N41H110 TEXT:"sweeping makeover of Washington."] A Trump-appointed board [USN:L1N4560T6 TEXT:"shut down"] the capital's landmark John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts after courts rejected two plans to put the president's name on the building. Some 71% of respondents oppose renaming the Kennedy Center to include Trump's name, the poll showed. Just a quarter of Republicans supported that idea. "For me to get involved and to take that on long term and to carry it or to raise money to carry it, I think that the Trump administration should certainly have recognition," Trump said last month. A MEDIA BAN AT THE WHITE HOUSE In September, Trump banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House before a judge ordered the administration to [USN:L1N45G0ZE TEXT:"restore their access"]. Republicans were more supportive of keeping some reporters out of the White House, with 57% backing the practice. Democrats and independents were overwhelmingly opposed. Overall, 68% of respondents said the practice was inappropriate. The Justice Department has accused the outlets of threatening national security with their coverage, citing stories about US missile stockpiles, construction of Trump's White House ballroom and turnout at the recent Republican midterm convention. The Reuters/Ipsos poll, which was conducted online and nationwide, gathered responses from 4,506 US adults and had a margin of error of about 2 percentage points.

Exclusive-Anthropic's Amodei made $18 million last year, middle of the tech CEO pack

NEW YORK/BOSTON, October 6 : Dario Amodei made $18 million last year as CEO of Claude AI developer Anthropic, the company's IPO filing shows, putting him in the middle ranks of top executives at major technology firms in terms of compensation. Anthropic is preparing for an IPO as early as this fall that could value it at more than $2 trillion, according to its IPO prospectus seen by Reuters. Amodei's pay last year puts him above CEOs at Alphabet and Amazon, but behind those at Oracle and Nvidia.  Amodei's pay leans heavily towards stock and other sorts of compensation, suggesting that like many other tech founders, his yearly salary will account for just a fraction of his wealth. Dario Amodei and his sister, Anthropic President Daniela Amodei, each had their annual salaries doubled this past July to $1.4 million. Stock and options awards made up the bulk of their packages in 2025, with Daniela Amodei receiving a total of $16.4 million last year.

Anthropic's board this year granted the pair the promise of further equity in the form of restricted stock units, which promise a future payout if certain conditions are met. Some of that is tied to their remaining at the company, and some of it is tied to the IPO. Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao earned $720,250 last year. He was granted options to buy 1.4 million shares when he was hired in 2024, and exercised options worth $385,285 in 2025. An Anthropic spokesperson declined to comment on the figures. MIDDLE OF THE PACK The rise in US CEO pay in recent years has far outpaced the gains for the average worker, a dynamic critics worry could be exacerbated by AI's widespread adoption. S&P 500 CEO average annual compensation rose 21 per cent to $22.8 million last year, and that does not include the extraordinary case of Tesla's Elon Musk and his $158 billion restricted stock plan, according to the AFL-CIO. Courtney Yu, director of research for executive compensation data firm Equilar, said Amodei's $18 million haul "seems on the lower end for a company valued at $2 trillion, but it will be interesting to see how that changes once the company goes public" and his full ownership stake is shown. With six other co-founders, Amodei may wind up getting a lesser share of the wealth created by the IPO compared with other major tech CEOs, Yu added. Top executives at AI-focused tech firms earned amounts that varied widely in 2025, based on SEC filings. At the high end, Oracle co-CEO Clayton Magouyrk earned $627.5 million, while the lowest was the $54,080 paid to Musk as CEO of SpaceX, before it went public. SpaceX has also promised super-voting restricted shares to Musk, already the world's richest person, if the company's market value grows to $7.5 trillion and the firm puts 1 million people on Mars. Other giant companies pay less on a year-by-year basis, with executives benefiting from enormous stock ownership while having only salary and security costs reflected in annual filings.  For instance, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai made $10.9 million in 2025, including $8.8 million for personal security "due to Sundar's significant public profile." By "compensation actually paid," Pichai earned $213.9 million last year, which among other things reflects the change in value of his unvested shares.  Amazon CEO Andrew Jassy made $2.1 million in 2025, a disclosure said, mainly reflecting travel and security. On an "actually paid" basis, Jassy received $13.2 million.  LIVING OFF THE STOCK Equilar's Yu said the disclosures show how these executives don't need to worry about year-by-year pay. "Founder CEOs typically own enough equity that when the company does well and the stock prices increases they can just live off the wealth of the equity they already own, and typically don't take in a lot in annual compensation," Yu said. Anthropic said in the filing it offered a mix of salary, equity awards and other benefits. The S-1 statement seen by Reuters does not describe the founders' share of ownership in the company, which could be worth billions of dollars, depending on the final terms and valuation of the IPO. The Amodei siblings and their fellow co-founders pledged in the IPO filing to dedicate 80 per cent of their personal Anthropic equity to charitable causes. Asked about the 80 per cent figure Monday, an Anthropic spokesperson noted an essay Dario Amodei posted earlier this year, where he wrote that wealthy individuals have an obligation to help address problems stemming from AI adoption, and decried that many wealthy people, particularly in the tech industry, "have recently adopted a cynical and nihilistic attitude that philanthropy is inevitably fraudulent or useless."

Source: Reuters

item.title: アンソロピックＣＥＯ、25年報酬1800万ドル 業界中位
item.description:
Echo Wang Ross Kerber Isla Binnie
[ニューヨーク／ボストン ６日 ロイター] - 人...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックＣＥＯ、25年報酬1800万ドル　業界中位 10/6 19:01 配信

写真はアントロピックのロゴとキーボード、ロボットの手のイメージ。6月5日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Echo Wang　Ross Kerber　Isla Binnie

[ニューヨーク／ボストン ６日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）「クロード」を開発するアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の２０２５年の報酬は１８００万ドルだった。同社の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類で明らかになった。大手テクノロジー企業の経営トップの中では中位に位置する。

ロイターが確認したＩＰＯ目論見書によると、アンソロピックは早ければ今秋の上場を準備しており、企業価値は２兆ドルを超える可能性がある。アモデイ氏の２５年の報酬は、アルファベットやアマゾン・ドット・コムのＣＥＯを上回る一方、オラクルやエヌビディアのＣＥＯには及ばなかった。

アモデイ氏の報酬は株式などに大きく偏っており、他の多くのテクノロジー企業創業者と同様、年間給与が資産に占める割合はごく一部にとどまるとみられる。

アモデイ氏と妹のダニエラ・アモデイ社長の年間給与は、７月にそれぞれ２倍の１４０万ドルに引き上げられた。２５年の報酬は両氏とも株式とストックオプション（自社株購入権）が大半を占め、ダニエラ氏の報酬総額は１６４０万ドルだった。

アンソロピックの取締役会は今年、両氏に対し譲渡制限付き株式ユニット（ＲＳＵ）の形で追加の株式を付与することを約束した。ＲＳＵは一定の条件を満たした場合に将来支払われる仕組みで、一部は在籍継続、一部はＩＰＯに連動している。

アンソロピックの広報担当者は、これらの数字についてコメントを控えた。

＜大手テクノロジー企業の中では中位＞

米労働総同盟産別会議（ＡＦＬ─ＣＩＯ）によると、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数構成企業のＣＥＯの平均年間報酬は２５年に２１％増の２２８０万ドルとなった。この数字には、テスラのイーロン・マスクＣＥＯに対する１５８０億ドルの譲渡制限付き株式報酬という例外的な事例は含まれていない。

役員報酬データ会社エクイラーの調査責任者コートニー・ユー氏は、アモデイ氏の１８００万ドルという報酬について「企業価値が２兆ドルの会社としては低い方に見える」とした上で、上場して同氏の保有株式の全容が明らかになった後、どう変わるかは興味深いと述べた。他に６人の共同創業者がいるため、アモデイ氏がＩＰＯによって生み出される富から得る取り分は、他の大手テクノロジー企業のＣＥＯより小さくなる可能性があるとした。

米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）への提出書類によると、ＡＩに注力するテクノロジー企業の経営トップの２５年報酬には大きな開きがあった。高額な例ではオラクルのクレイトン・マグワイク共同ＣＥＯが６億２７５０万ドルを受け取った。一方、最低だったのは、上場前のスペースＸのＣＥＯとしてマスク氏に支払われた５万４０８０ドルだった。スペースＸは、同社の時価総額が７兆５０００億ドルに達し、火星に１００万人を送り込んだ場合、マスク氏に対し、強力な議決権を持つ譲渡制限付き株式を付与することも約束している。

他の巨大企業では、経営幹部が巨額の保有株式から恩恵を受ける一方、年次開示には給与や警備費用のみが計上されるため、年間の報酬額は比較的少ない。

例えば、アルファベットのスンダー・ピチャイＣＥＯの２５年の報酬は１０９０万ドルだった。このうち８８０万ドルは「スンダー氏の社会的な知名度の高さを踏まえた」身辺警護費用だった。一方、未確定の株式報酬の価値変動などを反映する「実際に支払われた報酬」という開示上の指標では、２億１３９０万ドルだった。

item.title: シチズン、約10万人の顧客情報流出の恐れ 委託先企業に不正アクセス
item.description: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - シチズン時計は６日、委託先企業のサーバーが不正アクセスを受け、保存されていた約１０万人...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シチズン、約10万人の顧客情報流出の恐れ　委託先企業に不正アクセス 10/6 18:56 配信

写真はバイナリーコードと「データ流出」の文字、南京錠とパソコンを操作する人々のイメージ。2022年2月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - シチズン時計は６日、委託先企業のサーバーが不正アクセスを受け、保存されていた約１０万人の顧客情報が流出した可能性があると発表した。二次被害は確認されていないという。

シチズンが顧客からの問い合わせ受付業務を委託していたスカラコミュニケーションズによると、１０月２日夜から３日朝にかけて不正アクセスが発生。 約１０万人の氏名、住所、電話番号、メールアドレスなどが流出した可能性があるという。問い合わせ内容欄に銀行口座やクレジットカード情報などを記載していた場合は漏えいした可能性があるとしている。

対象はシチズン、ブローバ、フレデリック・コンスタントの各ブランドのホームページ。シチズン本体への不正アクセスは確認されていないという。

item.title: ASOS shares slide after hackers target online retailer
item.description: Shares in ASOS fell 10% on Tuesday after the British online fashion retailer warned that some customer information may have been accessed following the unauthorised sending of a notification to shoppers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shares in ASOS (ASOS.L) fell 10% on Tuesday after the British online fashion retailer warned that some customer information may have been accessed following the unauthorised sending of a notification to shoppers. The group said it was investigating unauthorised activity involving third-party platforms that it uses to communicate with customers. It said it took immediate action to restrict access to the platforms and was working with internal and external specialist advisers, as well as all relevant authorities. "Basic personal information including name and contact details may have been accessed. We do not believe that payment-card information or account passwords, were impacted," it said. The retailer's website and app were operating as normal, with no current disruption to operations, it said. British companies and institutions have been increasingly hit by aggressive and regular cyber and ransomware attacks in recent years. The British Library, a blood testing service, the London Underground, Marks & Spencer (MKS.L) , the Co-op and Jaguar Land Rover are some that have suffered months of disruption due to such breaches. HACKING GROUP 'XUANYE GROUP' CLAIMS RESPONSIBILITY The notifications to ASOS shoppers - addressed to ASOS' data protection officer and IT department - read, "we have fully compromised the Snowflake instance. Engage with us, or we will leak it." Snowflake is a data storage firm, whose tools are used by thousands of companies. A hacking group calling itself the "Xuanye group" claimed credit for compromising ASOS' Snowflake repository in the push alert sent to users of the retailer's app. The message included a link to a Telegram channel, where the group said that payment information "is not affected," and that the ASOS app "is safe to use." "The incident involves customer information, it is safe on our server, and it will not be touched for a designated period," the group said in a message posted to the channel. A spokesperson for Snowflake said it launched an investigation as soon as it became aware of the notification. "At this time, we can report that we have found no compromise of the Snowflake platform." Hackers have previously targeted organisations' Snowflake data repositories. In 2024, Google's (GOOGL.O) cybersecurity unit Mandiant detailed a widespread hacking spree targeting Snowflake data associated with at least 165 customers. ASOS said that it has cyber insurance, including basic continuity insurance, but said it was too early to quantify any potential impact on trading. Shares in the group were up more than 60% so far this year, though they are well below a peak in 2018 amid tough competition in fast fashion. The company has been divesting assets and last month provided an upbeat profit forecast for fiscal 2026.

item.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel physics prize for Antarctic 'ghost particle' hunt
item.description: STOCKHOLM: The Belgian-American Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work creating an Antarctic observatory of ice to detect high-energy neutrinos, elusive subatomic particles that can reveal otherwise inaccessible information about the cosmos.Halzen, 82, realised that pristine ice at th

Francis Halzen wins Nobel physics prize for Antarctic 'ghost particle' hunt

Eva Olsson, Ellen Moons, and Mark Pearce sit as they announce Francis Halzen as the recipient of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics during a press conference at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm, Sweden, Oct 6, 2026. (Photo: TT News Agency/Christine Olsson via REUTERS)

STOCKHOLM: The Belgian-American Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work creating an Antarctic observatory of ice to detect high-energy neutrinos, elusive subatomic particles that can reveal otherwise inaccessible information about the cosmos. Halzen, 82, realised that pristine ice at the South Pole could be used to track such neutrinos, sometimes known as "ghost particles" for the way they pass through the Earth without a trace, only interacting with matter extremely rarely. "The messengers bring information from the cosmos," Eva Olsson, of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, told a press conference. "They open the door to distant galaxies and tell us about the processes of exploding stars." HALZEN HAILED FOR DETECTING "MESSENGERS FROM THE COSMOS" The interactions registered by the IceCube observatory provide information about how high-energy neutrinos are created and may even reveal previously unknown phenomena, the Academy said.

In 2014, the US-based Smithsonian magazine dubbed Halzen "Neutrino Man" when giving him one of its Ingenuity Awards, acclaiming him for an "amazing experiment (that) heralds the beginning of a new era in astronomy". It even published a comic illustrating his life: "How One Physicist’s Pursuit of the Cosmos Took Off in Antarctica". The observatory - in effect a telescope that shows neutrinos instead of light - is set in a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice, which extends to a depth of 2,500 metres below the surface near the Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station. More than 5,000 sensors await blips from the nearly massless high-energy neutrinos, which unlike other particles do not lose energy or change direction, in the hope of tracing their paths back to exploding stars, gamma-ray bursts, and cataclysmic phenomena involving black holes and neutron stars. They can expect to register about one per day. Halzen, a professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison in the United States, first presented his idea in 1988 for capturing neutrino traces at the South Pole, but the project was not completed until 2011. "I have to emphasise how lucky I was because, when we started this project, everybody realised this was maybe a good idea, but very few thought it would work, including myself," Halzen told the press conference by telephone. Neutrinos are electrically neutral, undisturbed by any magnetic field, which means that, in contrast to electromagnetic waves such as visible light, the direction from which they arrive points directly back to their source.

Related:

Medicine Nobel goes to US-German trio for pioneering light-based control of cells

FRUITS OF HALZEN'S RESEARCH YET TO COME The observatory has determined that high-energy neutrinos originate within but also far outside our own Milky Way galaxy, setting in motion an interstellar quest to find the objects and processes that create them. Through the long winter at the South Pole, when bringing anything in or out is difficult as temperatures below minus 50°C (minus 58 Fahrenheit) preclude even aircraft landing, a skeleton crew of "winterovers" has to maintain the observatory. The station, home to many other activities, can house as many as 150 people and has an industrial kitchen, dining room, gym and even a greenhouse. Last week it celebrated the sun's return above the horizon after six months of night with a six-hole ice-golf tournament. An extension, IceCube-Gen2, encompassing 8 cubic kilometres of ice, is planned to become operational in 2033 and will be able to detect 10 times as many neutrinos, including much weaker ones. Halzen said the main fruits of his work were yet to be seen and that it was too early to say exactly what it could reveal about the universe. "The real excitement is that I cannot answer that question yet," he said. "This is just an introduction to the science, the astronomy is still to come." WINNERS FROM EINSTEIN TO BOHR AND THE CURIES Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever congratulated Halzen on the recognition of "a life dedicated to unraveling the greatest secrets of the cosmos through its most minuscule manifestations". The physics laureate receives an award of 12 million Swedish crowns (US$1.2 million). Past winners include several other neutrino research pioneers, for instance Japan's Takaaki Kajita and Arthur McDonald from Canada in 2015. The Nobel Prizes were established under the will of Swedish inventor and entrepreneur Alfred Nobel, whose fortune was built in part on the invention of dynamite. Physics was prominent in Nobel's will and the prize remains one of the discipline's highest distinctions. Over the decades, it has recognised discoveries that have fundamentally reshaped humanity's understanding of the universe. Among past laureates are some of the most celebrated figures in science, including Albert Einstein, Marie and Pierre Curie, Max Planck and Niels Bohr, whose work helped establish the foundations of modern physics. The prize is presented in Stockholm on Dec 10, the anniversary of Nobel's death.

Source: Reuters/fh

item.title: 英国経済、高インフレが定着＝中銀のマン委員
item.description: [ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英国経済、高インフレが定着＝中銀のマン委員 10/6 18:49 配信

写真はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員。2023年1月、英マンチェスターで撮影。REUTERS/Phil Noble

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日、２％の目標を上回るインフレが英国経済に定着してしまったようだと述べた。

経済助言会社ＴＳロンバードが主催した会議で「私がこの職に就いて以来、インフレ率は一貫して目標を大幅に上回ってきた。インフレは定着してしまった」と語った。

また、賃金交渉が活発化する年末年始ごろにインフレ率が４％に達する見通しであることに特に懸念を示した。

マン氏は、英国の経済需要は力強いとは思えないものの、ポジティブとの見解を示した。

さらに、最近の労働生産性データの上方改定が労働時間の下方改定によるものだったことに触れ、これが将来的にインフレを伴わない成長を実現する経済の能力を制限する可能性があるとの見解を示した。

マン氏は７月以来、政策金利を０．２５ポイント引き上げて４％とする案に賛成票を投じる少数派の一員となっている。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 最終更新: 10/6(火) 19:36 ロイター

item.title: ロシアのペスト研究所職員死亡、新たな感染の兆候なし＝ＷＨＯ
item.description: ［ジュネーブ ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ジュネーブ　６日　ロイター］ - 世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）は６日、ロシアのイルクーツクにあるペスト研究所で女性職員が死亡した事案について、ロシア当局が同日、当地でペストの症例は確認されていないとＷＨＯに報告したと明らかにした。

ＷＨＯのリンドマイヤー報道官が、ＷＨＯの照会に対するロシア側の公式回答を発表した。公式回答は「イルクーツク市において、この危険な疾患の症例は記録されていない」と表明。死亡した職員と接触した人々を特定し、危険な感染性病原体の検査結果は陰性だったとした。

検査結果について、死亡した職員に対しても検査を実施したのか、また職員についてペストの可能性を排除できたのか、ロイターは今のところ確認できていない。ジュネーブの国連ロシア代表部はコメント要請に応じていない。

item.title: Nigeria's Dangote refinery aims to draw more retail investors than Aramco IPO, CEO says
item.description: Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery is using Saudi Aramco's blockbuster listing as a benchmark for its own IPO in terms of retail subscribers, Chief Executive David Bird said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Vallari Srivastava, Sarah Safty
item.content:encoded: Nigeria's Dangote Petroleum Refinery is using Saudi Aramco's (2222.SE) blockbuster listing as a benchmark for its own IPO in terms of retail subscribers, Chief Executive David Bird said on Tuesday. Speaking at the Fujairah Energy Markets Forum, Bird said the refinery is targeting 10 million retail investors for its planned initial public offering. Last month, Nigeria's Dangote Group [USN:L4N4511G5 TEXT:"launched"] Africa's largest share sale yet in an initial public offering of its oil refinery that could raise 2.15 trillion naira ($1.6 billion), if fully subscribed. Aramco, which raised [USN:KBN1ZB03C TEXT:"$29.4 billion"] in its 2019 IPO by over-allotment of shares, had said it would sell up to 0.5% of the state oil giant to retail investors. "Our benchmark is the Aramco listing, which I think (had) over 4.5 million retail subscribers," Bird said. "So we are going to try and smash that with 10 million retail subscribers and we are well on our way."

item.title: ＥＣＢ安全網、議論の時期ではない＝フィンランド中銀総裁
item.description: [ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、最近...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ安全網、議論の時期ではない＝フィンランド中銀総裁 10/6 18:36 配信

写真は欧州中央銀行（ECB）本部ビルの外に掲げられたロゴ。2018年4月、フランクフルトで撮影。REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

[ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、最近の債券利回り上昇にもかかわらず、ユーロ圏の金融政策伝達メカニズムは適切に機能しているとし、ＥＣＢのセーフティーネット（安全網）について議論する時期ではないと述べた。

ＥＣＢがフランス債券市場への支援を検討すべきかとの問いに、フランス銀行（中銀）のムーラン総裁の見解に「全面的に同意する」と回答。そのような支援の議論は時宜を得ておらず、各国は自国の財政の持続可能性を確保しなければならないとの考えを示した。

item.title: アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日）
item.description: 香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。 ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日） 10/6 18:34 配信

香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。    ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１％近く上昇した。    ハンセン・バイオテック指数は３．２%上昇し、ハンセン・テック指数は０．９%上昇した。    HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。    半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。    ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。    新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。    中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

休場明けのソウル株式市場は下落。今週発表されるサムスン電子の決算を控え、半導体株が売られた。

未来アセット証券のアナリスト、ソ・サンヨン氏は「メモリー半導体価格の継続的な上昇を背景にサムスン電子の決算は良好な内容になるとみられるが、債券利回りの高止まりが相場全般の重しとなっている」と指摘した。

半導体のサムスン電子は１．４５％安、同業のＳＫハイニックスは３．６９％下落した。

電池メーカーのＬＧエネルギーソリューションが５．１２％上昇。現代自動車は０．４３％高、傘下の起亜は０．２７％安だった。

売買された９１８銘柄のうち、値上がりは４２５、値下がりは４６１。

外国人投資家は差し引き１兆８０００億ウォン（１３億４０００万ドル）の売り越し。

シドニー株式市場は３営業日続伸して取引を終えた。銅価格の上昇を背景に主力鉱山株が買われたほか、原油安でインフレ懸念が和らいだ。

金融株指数は０．７％上昇し、３営業日続伸。４大銀行は全て上昇し、上昇率は０．６─０．８％だった。不動産株指数は１．１％上昇し、４営業日ぶりに反発した。センター・グループは２．７％、ＧＰＴグループは２．３％それぞれ上昇した。

鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇を受けて０．９％上昇した。業界大手のＢＨＰグループは１．６％高となり、約１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。ハイテク株指数は３％近く下落し、１カ月余りで最大の下落率を記録した。ワイズテック・グローバルは２．５％下落し、下げを主導した。

item.title: 英建設ＰＭＩ、9月46.1に改善 新規受注は引き続き低迷
item.description:
David Milliken
[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが６日発表した英国の９月の建設業購買担...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英建設ＰＭＩ、9月46.1に改善　新規受注は引き続き低迷 10/6 18:31 配信

写真は6月9日、ロンドンの建設現場で撮影。REUTERS/Chris J. Ratcliffe

David Milliken

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが６日発表した英国の９月の建設業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４６．１だった。８月の４４．３から改善したものの、好不況の分かれ目である５０を引き続き下回った。ただ落ち込みは１月以降で最も穏やかだった。

英建設業ＰＭＩは２０２５年１月から５０を下回っている。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスの経済ディレクター、ティム・ムーア氏は「９月の新規受注は相対的に低迷した。建設企業は営業から受注までの期間が長期化しており、顧客が大型プロジェクトの意思決定を先送りにしていると指摘した」と述べた。

・新規受注指数は４５．９で、前月の４７．７から低下し３カ月ぶりの低水準。

・投入価格の上昇率は２月のイラン戦争勃発以来、最も緩やかなペースとなった。ただしムーア氏は、エネルギーコストの上昇を踏まえると、この傾向が続く可能性は低いと述べた。

・今後の活動見通しは５月以来で最も弱かった。

・部門別では住宅建設が引き続き最も低調で、土木工事がこれに続いた。一方、商業施設は小幅な低下にとどまった。

・サービス、製造業、建設業のＰＭＩデータを含む全セクターＰＭＩは５１．５で前月の５１．８から低下し、３カ月ぶりの低水準。
